# 1. Study design

This study examines land-cover patterns and changes in Tharaka
Sub-county, Tharaka Nithi County, Kenya.

The target years are 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025.

The land-cover classes of interest are:

- Forest
- Bushland
- Grassland
- Cultivated farmland
- Settlement

Four observation windows will be investigated:

| Season | Window |
|---|---|
| Dry | February 10–20 |
| Dry | September 15–25 |
| Wet | May 5–30 |
| Wet | December 5–30 |

The initial stage retrieves and prepares satellite imagery.
Classification and accuracy assessment will follow after suitable
training samples have been established.

# 2. Obtain Kenya's administrative boundaries

```{r gadm-boundaries}
# =========================================================
# 2. DOWNLOAD GADM LEVEL-2 BOUNDARIES
# =========================================================

kenya_adm2 <- geodata::gadm(
  country = "KEN",
  level = 2,
  path = "01_data/boundary"
)

print(kenya_adm2)
print(names(kenya_adm2))

# Inspect all available second-level administrative names
sort(unique(kenya_adm2$NAME_2))

# Identify possible Tharaka matches
grep(
  "Tharaka",
  unique(kenya_adm2$NAME_2),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# List level-2 units within Tharaka-Nithi County
sort(unique(
  kenya_adm2$NAME_2[
    kenya_adm2$NAME_1 == "Tharaka-Nithi"
  ]
))
```

# 3. Extract and save Tharaka Sub-county

```{r study-boundary}
# =========================================================
# 3. EXTRACT THE STUDY AREA
# =========================================================

tharaka <- kenya_adm2[
  kenya_adm2$NAME_2 == "Tharaka" &
    kenya_adm2$NAME_1 == "Tharaka-Nithi",
]

if (nrow(tharaka) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one Tharaka feature. ",
    "Inspect the administrative names printed above ",
    "and adjust the selection before continuing."
  )
}

study_area <- tharaka

# Inspect the boundary
print(study_area)
print(terra::crs(study_area))

plot(
  study_area,
  col = "lightgreen",
  main = "Tharaka Sub-county Study Area"
)

# Save vector boundary
terra::writeVector(
  study_area,
  "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.shp",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Save native R object
saveRDS(
  study_area,
  "01_data/boundary/tharaka_study_area.rds"
)

# Calculate approximate area
area_km2 <- sum(
  terra::expanse(study_area, unit = "km")
)

print(area_km2)

# Convert to sf and use geographic coordinates for Earth Engine
study_area_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(study_area)

study_area_sf <- sf::st_transform(
  study_area_sf,
  4326
)

print(sf::st_bbox(study_area_sf))
```

# 4. Initialize Google Earth Engine

The Earth Engine API is installed in the dedicated `rgee`
Python environment. A previous initialization attempt reached
the API but reported that the Cloud Asset root was missing.

The code below catches that particular initialization error and
checks whether a basic Earth Engine request still works. It does
not suppress a genuine failure to access Earth Engine.

```{r earth-engine-setup}

# =========================================================
# 4. EARTH ENGINE CONNECTION
# =========================================================

ee_project <- "thinking-leaf-305215"

# Import Earth Engine API
ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)

# Initialize Earth Engine directly; bypass rgee asset-root prompts
ee$Initialize(project = ee_project)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Test 1: Basic API request
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ee_test <- reticulate::py_to_r(
  ee$Number(1)$getInfo()
)

stopifnot(as.numeric(ee_test) == 1)

message("Basic Earth Engine request succeeded.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Test 2: Landsat collection access
# ---------------------------------------------------------

landsat_test <- reticulate::py_to_r(
  ee$
    ImageCollection("LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2")$
    limit(1)$
    size()$
    getInfo()
)

stopifnot(as.numeric(landsat_test) == 1)

message("Landsat collection access succeeded.")
message("Earth Engine project: ", ee_project)

```

# 7. Cloud masking and Landsat band harmonization

The code uses Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance.
The common output bands are blue, green, red, near-infrared,
shortwave infrared 1 and shortwave infrared 2.

```{r landsat-functions}
# =========================================================
# 7. LANDSAT MASKING AND SCALING
# =========================================================

mask_scale_l57 <- function(img) {

  qa <- img$select("QA_PIXEL")

  # Mask fill, dilated cloud, cirrus bit, cloud,
  # cloud shadow and snow flags.
  mask <- qa$bitwiseAnd(63)$eq(0)

  saturation <- img$select("QA_RADSAT")$eq(0)

  img$
    updateMask(mask)$
    updateMask(saturation)$
    select(
      c(
        "SR_B1", "SR_B2", "SR_B3",
        "SR_B4", "SR_B5", "SR_B7"
      ),
      c(
        "blue", "green", "red",
        "nir", "swir1", "swir2"
      )
    )$
    multiply(0.0000275)$
    add(-0.2)
}

mask_scale_l89 <- function(img) {

  qa <- img$select("QA_PIXEL")

  mask <- qa$bitwiseAnd(63)$eq(0)

  saturation <- img$select("QA_RADSAT")$eq(0)

  img$
    updateMask(mask)$
    updateMask(saturation)$
    select(
      c(
        "SR_B2", "SR_B3", "SR_B4",
        "SR_B5", "SR_B6", "SR_B7"
      ),
      c(
        "blue", "green", "red",
        "nir", "swir1", "swir2"
      )
    )$
    multiply(0.0000275)$
    add(-0.2)
}


```


```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 7: TARGET AND EXPANDED SEASONAL WINDOWS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)

years <- c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2025)

# Original target windows
windows <- tibble::tribble(
  ~window,    ~season, ~start_month, ~start_day, ~end_month, ~end_day,
  "dry_feb",  "Dry",   2,            10,         2,          20,
  "dry_sep",  "Dry",   9,            15,         9,          25,
  "wet_may",  "Wet",   5,             5,         5,          30,
  "wet_dec",  "Wet",  12,             5,        12,          30
)

# Option B parameters
buffer_days <- 30

# Coverage criteria for this preliminary assessment
min_scenes <- 2
coverage_threshold <- 0.70

# Expand each target window by 30 days at each end.
# Earth Engine filterDate() uses an exclusive end date.
window_schedule <- tidyr::crossing(
  year = years,
  windows
) %>%
  mutate(
    target_start = as.Date(sprintf(
      "%04d-%02d-%02d", year, start_month, start_day
    )),
    target_end = as.Date(sprintf(
      "%04d-%02d-%02d", year, end_month, end_day
    )),
    expanded_start = target_start - buffer_days,
    expanded_end = target_end + buffer_days,
    expanded_end_exclusive = expanded_end + 1,
    key = paste(year, window, sep = "_")
  )

print(
  window_schedule %>%
    select(
      year, window, season, target_start, target_end,
      expanded_start, expanded_end
    )
)

```


# 8. Create seasonal Landsat composites

Landsat 5 and 7 are used for earlier years; Landsat 8 and 9
contribute when available for later years. Collections are merged
after the bands have been standardized.

The end date is exclusive in Earth Engine, so one day is added
to include the requested final day.

```{r seasonal-composites}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 8: LANDSAT PREPROCESSING FUNCTIONS
# =========================================================

mask_scale_l57 <- function(image) {

  qa <- image$select("QA_PIXEL")

  mask <- qa$bitwiseAnd(1)$eq(0)$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(2)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(8)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(16)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(32)$eq(0))

  saturation_mask <- image$select("QA_RADSAT")$eq(0)

  reflectance <- image$select(
    c("SR_B1", "SR_B2", "SR_B3",
      "SR_B4", "SR_B5", "SR_B7"),
    c("blue", "green", "red",
      "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
  )$multiply(0.0000275)$add(-0.2)

  processed <- reflectance$
    updateMask(mask)$
    updateMask(saturation_mask)

  processed$copyProperties(
    image,
    c("system:time_start", "system:index")
  )
}


mask_scale_l89 <- function(image) {

  qa <- image$select("QA_PIXEL")

  mask <- qa$bitwiseAnd(1)$eq(0)$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(2)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(4)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(8)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(16)$eq(0))$
    And(qa$bitwiseAnd(32)$eq(0))

  saturation_mask <- image$select("QA_RADSAT")$eq(0)

  reflectance <- image$select(
    c("SR_B2", "SR_B3", "SR_B4",
      "SR_B5", "SR_B6", "SR_B7"),
    c("blue", "green", "red",
      "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
  )$multiply(0.0000275)$add(-0.2)

  processed <- reflectance$
    updateMask(mask)$
    updateMask(saturation_mask)

  processed$copyProperties(
    image,
    c("system:time_start", "system:index")
  )
}

```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 9: EXPANDED-WINDOW AVAILABILITY AND COVERAGE
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)

ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)

# Ensure Earth Engine is initialized.
ee$Initialize(project = "thinking-leaf-305215")

# Helper: call a Python method explicitly.
ee_method <- function(object, method, ...) {
  fn <- reticulate::py_get_attr(object, method)
  reticulate::py_call(fn, ...)
}

# Helper: safely retrieve an Earth Engine result.
ee_get_info <- function(object) {
  reticulate::py_to_r(
    ee_method(object, "getInfo")
  )
}

# Python callbacks for Earth Engine server-side mapping.
# These call the preprocessing functions defined in Section 8.
preprocess_l57_py <- reticulate::py_eval(
  paste0(
    "lambda image: image.select(",
    "['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B7'], ",
    "['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2'])",
    ".multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)",
    ".updateMask(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(2).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(16).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0))))))",
    ".updateMask(image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0))",
    ".copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start','system:index'])"
  ),
  convert = FALSE
)

preprocess_l89_py <- reticulate::py_eval(
  paste0(
    "lambda image: image.select(",
    "['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'], ",
    "['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2'])",
    ".multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)",
    ".updateMask(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(2).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(4).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(16).eq(0)",
    ".And(image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0)))))))",
    ".updateMask(image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0))",
    ".copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start','system:index'])"
  ),
  convert = FALSE
)

sensor_specs <- list(
  list(
    id = "LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2",
    callback = preprocess_l57_py
  ),
  list(
    id = "LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2",
    callback = preprocess_l57_py
  ),
  list(
    id = "LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2",
    callback = preprocess_l89_py
  ),
  list(
    id = "LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2",
    callback = preprocess_l89_py
  )
)

min_scenes <- 2
coverage_threshold <- 0.70

get_window_result <- function(year, window, target_start,
                              target_end, expanded_start,
                              expanded_end_exclusive, key) {

  message("Checking: ", key)

  start_string <- format(expanded_start, "%Y-%m-%d")
  end_string <- format(expanded_end_exclusive, "%Y-%m-%d")

  scene_count <- 0L
  dates <- character(0)
  processed_collections <- list()

  for (sensor in sensor_specs) {

    raw <- ee$ImageCollection(sensor$id)
    raw <- ee_method(raw, "filterDate", start_string, end_string)
    raw <- ee_method(raw, "filterBounds", roi)

    n <- tryCatch(
      as.integer(ee_get_info(ee_method(raw, "size"))),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Scene-count error for ", sensor$id, ": ",
                conditionMessage(e))
        0L
      }
    )

    scene_count <- scene_count + n

    if (n > 0L) {

      # Extract dates from the original collection.
      date_callback <- reticulate::py_eval(
        "lambda image: image.set('acq_date', image.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'))",
        convert = FALSE
      )

      dated_raw <- ee_method(raw, "map", date_callback)

      sensor_dates <- tryCatch(
        ee_get_info(ee_method(dated_raw, "aggregate_array", "acq_date")),
        error = function(e) {
          message("Date extraction failed for ", sensor$id, ": ",
                  conditionMessage(e))
          character(0)
        }
      )

      dates <- c(dates, as.character(unlist(sensor_dates)))

      processed <- ee_method(raw, "map", sensor$callback)
      processed_collections[[length(processed_collections) + 1L]] <-
        processed
    }
  }

  dates <- sort(unique(dates))

  if (scene_count == 0L || length(processed_collections) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      summary = tibble(
        year = year,
        window = window,
        key = key,
        target_start = as.character(target_start),
        target_end = as.character(target_end),
        expanded_start = start_string,
        expanded_end = as.character(expanded_end_exclusive - 1),
        scene_count = scene_count,
        unique_acquisition_dates = length(dates),
        acquisition_dates = paste(dates, collapse = "; "),
        valid_pixel_coverage = NA_real_,
        coverage_status = "no_scenes"
      ),
      image = NULL
    ))
  }

  # Merge processed collections.
  merged <- processed_collections[[1]]

  if (length(processed_collections) > 1L) {
    for (j in 2:length(processed_collections)) {
      merged <- ee_method(
        merged, "merge", processed_collections[[j]]
      )
    }
  }

  composite <- ee_method(merged, "median")
  composite <- ee_method(composite, "clip", roi)

  coverage <- tryCatch({

    valid_mask <- ee_method(composite, "select",
                            c("blue", "green", "red",
                              "nir", "swir1", "swir2"))
    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "mask")
    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "reduce", ee$Reducer$min())
    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "rename", "valid")

    coverage_dictionary <- ee_method(
      valid_mask, "reduceRegion",
      reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 30,
      maxPixels = 1e9,
      bestEffort = TRUE
    )

    coverage_values <- ee_get_info(coverage_dictionary)
    value <- coverage_values[["valid"]]

    if (is.null(value)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(value)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Coverage calculation failed for ", key, ": ",
            conditionMessage(e))
    NA_real_
  })

  status <- if (is.na(coverage)) {
    "coverage_unavailable"
  } else if (scene_count < min_scenes) {
    "insufficient_scenes"
  } else if (coverage < coverage_threshold) {
    "low_valid_pixel_coverage"
  } else {
    "adequate_coverage"
  }

  list(
    summary = tibble(
      year = year,
      window = window,
      key = key,
      target_start = as.character(target_start),
      target_end = as.character(target_end),
      expanded_start = start_string,
      expanded_end = as.character(expanded_end_exclusive - 1),
      scene_count = scene_count,
      unique_acquisition_dates = length(dates),
      acquisition_dates = paste(dates, collapse = "; "),
      valid_pixel_coverage = coverage,
      coverage_status = status
    ),
    image = composite
  )
}
```


```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 9B: RESUMABLE WINDOW PROCESSING AND SAFE EXTRACTION
# =========================================================

# Remove any R-level time limit that might interrupt processing.
setTimeLimit(
  cpu = Inf,
  elapsed = Inf,
  transient = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Initialize or reuse existing results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

expected_keys <- as.character(window_schedule$key)

if (
  !exists("window_results", inherits = FALSE) ||
  !is.list(window_results) ||
  !identical(names(window_results), expected_keys)
) {
  window_results <- setNames(
    vector("list", length(expected_keys)),
    expected_keys
  )
} else {
  message("Reusing existing window_results.")
}

# Create the composite registry BEFORE processing. Each successful image is
# registered immediately below, so a later-window problem cannot prevent the
# earlier composites from being available to later sections.
# NOTE: RStudio may print `reached elapsed time limit` from
# .Call(`_reticulate_py_str_impl`, x) while its Environment pane tries to
# summarise an Earth Engine Python proxy. That IDE inspection warning does
# not by itself prove the assignment failed; use the checks below to confirm.
seasonal_composites <- setNames(
  vector("list", length(expected_keys)),
  expected_keys
)

# Output files: save checkpoints after each window
availability_file <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Expanded_Window_Summary.csv"

dates_file <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Acquisition_Dates.csv"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Helper to save all completed summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

save_availability_outputs <- function(results) {

  valid_results <- Filter(
    function(x) {
      is.list(x) &&
        !is.null(x$summary)
    },
    results
  )

  if (length(valid_results) == 0L) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  availability_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(valid_results, function(x) x$summary)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      valid_pixel_coverage_pct =
        round(100 * valid_pixel_coverage, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      year,
      match(
        window,
        c("dry_feb", "dry_sep", "wet_may", "wet_dec")
      )
    )

  readr::write_csv(
    availability_summary,
    availability_file
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    availability_summary %>%
      select(
        year, window, target_start, target_end,
        expanded_start, expanded_end,
        scene_count, unique_acquisition_dates,
        acquisition_dates, coverage_status
      ),
    dates_file
  )

  invisible(availability_summary)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Process only missing or previously failed windows
# ---------------------------------------------------------

for (i in seq_len(nrow(window_schedule))) {

  w <- window_schedule[i, ]
  key <- as.character(w$key)

  previous <- window_results[[key]]

  already_completed <-
    is.list(previous) &&
    !is.null(previous$summary) &&
    !identical(
      as.character(previous$summary$coverage_status[1]),
      "processing_error"
    )

  if (already_completed) {
    # Restore the image into the registry when re-running this chunk in an
    # existing R session.
    seasonal_composites[[key]] <- previous[["image"]]
    message("Skipping completed window: ", key)
    next
  }

  message("\nProcessing window: ", key)

  result <- tryCatch(
    get_window_result(
      year = w$year,
      window = w$window,
      target_start = w$target_start,
      target_end = w$target_end,
      expanded_start = w$expanded_start,
      expanded_end_exclusive = w$expanded_end_exclusive,
      key = key
    ),
    error = function(e) {

      message(
        "Window failed: ", key,
        " | ", conditionMessage(e)
      )

      list(
        summary = tibble(
          year = w$year,
          window = w$window,
          key = key,
          target_start = as.character(w$target_start),
          target_end = as.character(w$target_end),
          expanded_start = as.character(w$expanded_start),
          expanded_end = as.character(
            w$expanded_end_exclusive - 1
          ),
          scene_count = NA_integer_,
          unique_acquisition_dates = NA_integer_,
          acquisition_dates = NA_character_,
          valid_pixel_coverage = NA_real_,
          coverage_status = "processing_error"
        ),
        image = NULL
      )
    }
  )

  # Retain the result and register its Earth Engine image immediately.
  # The image remains a server-side Earth Engine object; no raster download
  # or Python-to-R conversion is performed here.
  window_results[[key]] <- result
  seasonal_composites[[key]] <- result[["image"]]

  # Save progress even if a later window fails.
  save_availability_outputs(window_results)

  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validate the registry without printing Python-backed objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Populate any missing registry entries from completed checkpoint results.
# This supports resuming the chunk after an interrupted RStudio session.
for (key in expected_keys) {
  if (is.null(seasonal_composites[[key]])) {
    result <- window_results[[key]]
    if (is.list(result) && "image" %in% names(result)) {
      seasonal_composites[[key]] <- result[["image"]]
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Final summary and checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------

availability_summary <- save_availability_outputs(
  window_results
)

cat("\n===== PROCESSING STATUS =====\n")

if (!is.null(availability_summary)) {
  print(
    availability_summary %>%
      select(
        year, window, scene_count,
        valid_pixel_coverage_pct, coverage_status
      ),
    n = Inf
  )
}

cat(
  "\nComposite images retained:",
  sum(!vapply(seasonal_composites, is.null, logical(1))),
  "of", length(seasonal_composites), "\n"
)

cat(
  "Availability summary:",
  normalizePath(availability_file, mustWork = FALSE), "\n"
)

cat(
  "Acquisition dates:",
  normalizePath(dates_file, mustWork = FALSE), "\n"
)


```

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
```

# 9. Check scene availability

```{r scene-summary}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 10: VALIDATE ORIGINAL TARGET WINDOWS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# Server-side callback to attach a readable acquisition date.
date_callback <- reticulate::py_eval(
  "lambda image: image.set('acq_date', image.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'))",
  convert = FALSE
)

validate_one_window <- function(w) {

  message("Validating target window: ", w$key)

  target_start <- as.character(w$target_start)
  target_end_exclusive <- as.character(w$target_end + 1)

  target_scene_count <- 0L
  target_dates <- character(0)

  # Count and list acquisitions inside the ORIGINAL target dates.
  for (sensor in sensor_specs) {

    raw <- ee$ImageCollection(sensor$id)
    raw <- ee_method(
      raw, "filterDate",
      target_start, target_end_exclusive
    )
    raw <- ee_method(raw, "filterBounds", roi)

    n <- tryCatch(
      as.integer(ee_get_info(ee_method(raw, "size"))),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Target scene count failed for ",
                sensor$id, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
        0L
      }
    )

    target_scene_count <- target_scene_count + n

    if (n > 0L) {
      dated_raw <- ee_method(raw, "map", date_callback)

      dates_sensor <- tryCatch(
        ee_get_info(
          ee_method(dated_raw, "aggregate_array", "acq_date")
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          message("Target date extraction failed for ",
                  sensor$id, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
          character(0)
        }
      )

      target_dates <- c(
        target_dates,
        as.character(unlist(dates_sensor))
      )
    }
  }

  target_dates <- sort(unique(target_dates))

  # Recalculate coverage for the existing expanded-window composite
  # at a fixed 30 m scale, without bestEffort.
  composite <- seasonal_composites[[w$key]]

  fixed_scale_coverage <- tryCatch({

    if (is.null(composite)) {
      stop("No expanded-window composite is available.")
    }

    valid_mask <- ee_method(
      composite, "select",
      c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
    )

    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "mask")
    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "reduce", ee$Reducer$min())
    valid_mask <- ee_method(valid_mask, "rename", "valid")

    coverage_dictionary <- ee_method(
      valid_mask, "reduceRegion",
      reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 30,
      maxPixels = 1e10,
      tileScale = 4
    )

    coverage_values <- ee_get_info(coverage_dictionary)
    coverage_value <- coverage_values[["valid"]]

    if (is.null(coverage_value)) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      as.numeric(coverage_value)
    }

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Fixed-scale coverage failed for ", w$key, ": ",
            conditionMessage(e))
    NA_real_
  })

  target_status <- if (target_scene_count == 0L) {
    "buffer_only_no_target_scenes"
  } else {
    "target_window_has_scenes"
  }

  coverage_status <- if (is.na(fixed_scale_coverage)) {
    "coverage_unavailable"
  } else if (fixed_scale_coverage < coverage_threshold) {
    "low_valid_pixel_coverage"
  } else {
    "coverage_passes_threshold"
  }

  tibble(
    year = w$year,
    window = w$window,
    key = w$key,
    target_start = target_start,
    target_end = as.character(w$target_end),
    expanded_start = as.character(w$expanded_start),
    expanded_end = as.character(w$expanded_end),
    expanded_scene_count = as.integer(
      availability_summary$scene_count[
        match(w$key, availability_summary$key)
      ]
    ),
    target_scene_count = target_scene_count,
    unique_target_dates = length(target_dates),
    target_acquisition_dates = paste(target_dates, collapse = "; "),
    fixed_scale_coverage = fixed_scale_coverage,
    fixed_scale_coverage_pct = round(
      100 * fixed_scale_coverage, 2
    ),
    target_status = target_status,
    coverage_status = coverage_status
  )
}

# Validate all 16 windows.
target_validation <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(window_schedule)), function(i) {
    validate_one_window(window_schedule[i, ])
  })
) %>%
  arrange(year, match(window, windows$window))

print(target_validation, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Export the validation report.
readr::write_csv(
  target_validation,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Target_Window_Validation.csv"
)

```

# 10. Optional target-window composite analysis

The optional chunk below rebuilds composites using only acquisitions
inside the exact target dates and compares them with the expanded-window
results. It is disabled by default because it issues additional Earth
Engine queries for the 16 windows. Section 12 uses the expanded-window
composites created in Section 9B and does not depend on this optional chunk.

```{r target-window-selection-optional, eval=FALSE}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 11: TARGET COMPOSITES AND FINAL DATA SELECTION
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# Calculate valid-pixel coverage for a composite at fixed 30 m.
get_fixed_coverage <- function(image) {

  if (is.null(image)) return(NA_real_)

  tryCatch({

    valid <- ee_method(
      image, "select",
      c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
    )

    valid <- ee_method(valid, "mask")
    valid <- ee_method(valid, "reduce", ee$Reducer$min())
    valid <- ee_method(valid, "rename", "valid")

    result <- ee_method(
      valid, "reduceRegion",
      reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 30,
      maxPixels = 1e10,
      tileScale = 4
    )

    values <- ee_get_info(result)
    x <- values[["valid"]]

    if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Coverage calculation failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NA_real_
  })
}


# Build a composite using acquisitions inside the original target dates.
build_target_composite <- function(w) {

  message("Building target-only composite: ", w$key)

  start <- as.character(w$target_start)
  end_exclusive <- as.character(w$target_end + 1)

  collections <- list()
  total_scenes <- 0L

  for (sensor in sensor_specs) {

    raw <- ee$ImageCollection(sensor$id)
    raw <- ee_method(raw, "filterDate", start, end_exclusive)
    raw <- ee_method(raw, "filterBounds", roi)

    n <- tryCatch(
      as.integer(ee_get_info(ee_method(raw, "size"))),
      error = function(e) 0L
    )

    total_scenes <- total_scenes + n

    if (n > 0L) {
      collections[[length(collections) + 1L]] <-
        ee_method(raw, "map", sensor$callback)
    }
  }

  if (total_scenes == 0L || length(collections) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      image = NULL,
      scene_count = total_scenes,
      coverage = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  merged <- collections[[1]]

  if (length(collections) > 1L) {
    for (j in 2:length(collections)) {
      merged <- ee_method(merged, "merge", collections[[j]])
    }
  }

  composite <- ee_method(merged, "median")
  composite <- ee_method(composite, "clip", roi)

  list(
    image = composite,
    scene_count = total_scenes,
    coverage = get_fixed_coverage(composite)
  )
}


# Build target composites for all 16 combinations.
target_composites <- vector("list", nrow(window_schedule))
names(target_composites) <- window_schedule$key

target_composite_results <- vector("list", nrow(window_schedule))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(window_schedule))) {

  w <- window_schedule[i, ]

  result <- build_target_composite(w)

  target_composites[[w$key]] <- result$image

  target_composite_results[[i]] <- tibble(
    key = w$key,
    target_scene_count_rechecked = result$scene_count,
    target_fixed_coverage = result$coverage,
    target_fixed_coverage_pct = round(100 * result$coverage, 2)
  )
}

target_composite_summary <- bind_rows(target_composite_results)


# Join target-only and expanded-window assessment results.
selection_table <- target_validation %>%
  left_join(
    target_composite_summary,
    by = "key"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    availability_summary %>%
      select(
        key,
        expanded_coverage_original = valid_pixel_coverage,
        expanded_coverage_original_pct = valid_pixel_coverage_pct,
        expanded_acquisition_dates = acquisition_dates
      ),
    by = "key"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_support = case_when(
      target_scene_count_rechecked == 0 ~ "buffer_dependent",
      target_scene_count_rechecked <= 2 ~ "limited_target_support",
      TRUE ~ "multiple_target_scenes"
    ),

    target_coverage_pass = !is.na(target_fixed_coverage) &
      target_fixed_coverage >= coverage_threshold,

    expanded_coverage_pass = !is.na(expanded_coverage_original) &
      expanded_coverage_original >= coverage_threshold,

    selection_recommendation = case_when(
      target_scene_count_rechecked > 0 &
        target_coverage_pass &
        target_scene_count_rechecked >= 3 ~
        "prefer_target_window",

      target_scene_count_rechecked > 0 &
        target_coverage_pass ~
        "target_window_candidate_limited_dates",

      target_scene_count_rechecked == 0 &
        expanded_coverage_pass ~
        "expanded_window_fallback_requires_review",

      expanded_coverage_pass ~
        "review_target_and_expanded_data",

      TRUE ~
        "manual_review_required"
    ),

    selection_reason = case_when(
      selection_recommendation == "prefer_target_window" ~
        "At least three target-window scenes and coverage passes screening threshold",

      selection_recommendation == "target_window_candidate_limited_dates" ~
        "Target-window scenes exist, but temporal support is limited",

      selection_recommendation == "expanded_window_fallback_requires_review" ~
        "No target-window scenes; expanded imagery is a possible substitute",

      selection_recommendation == "review_target_and_expanded_data" ~
        "Target coverage does not pass; inspect both composites",

      TRUE ~
        "Coverage is unavailable or inadequate"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, match(window, windows$window))


# Inspect the final acquisition-selection table.
print(
  selection_table %>%
    select(
      year, window,
      target_scene_count_rechecked,
      target_fixed_coverage_pct,
      expanded_scene_count,
      expanded_coverage_original_pct,
      target_support,
      selection_recommendation,
      selection_reason
    ),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

# Save the full decision table.
readr::write_csv(
  selection_table,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Acquisition_Selection.csv"
)

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 12: FINAL COMPOSITE SELECTION AND VALIDATION
# Tharaka Sub-County Land-Cover Analysis
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)

# Remove any R-level time limit that could interrupt processing
setTimeLimit(
  cpu = Inf,
  elapsed = Inf,
  transient = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.1. Validate required objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Recovery path: if a prior run built window_results but stopped before the
# composite registry was assembled, rebuild the registry from those results.
# This does not rerun Earth Engine queries.
if (
  !exists("seasonal_composites", inherits = TRUE) &&
  exists("window_results", inherits = TRUE) &&
  is.list(window_results)
) {
  seasonal_composites <- setNames(
    lapply(window_results, function(result) {
      if (is.list(result) && "image" %in% names(result)) {
        result[["image"]]
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }),
    names(window_results)
  )
}

required_objects <- c(
  "window_schedule",
  "availability_summary",
  "seasonal_composites"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Section 12 cannot proceed because these prerequisites are missing: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    ". Run the document from the beginning through Section 9B. " ,
    "Do not execute Section 12 by itself in a fresh R session."
  )
}

# Confirm that the schedule and composites have matching keys
expected_keys <- as.character(window_schedule$key)
composite_keys <- names(seasonal_composites)

if (is.null(composite_keys)) {
  stop("seasonal_composites must be a named list.")
}

missing_composites <- setdiff(expected_keys, composite_keys)

if (length(missing_composites) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing composite keys: ",
    paste(missing_composites, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Check which composites contain live Earth Engine images
image_available <- vapply(
  expected_keys,
  function(k) {
    !is.null(seasonal_composites[[k]])
  },
  logical(1)
)

composite_status <- tibble(
  key = expected_keys,
  image_available = image_available
)

print(composite_status, n = Inf)

if (!all(image_available)) {
  stop(
    "Some seasonal composites are unavailable. ",
    "Review composite_status before proceeding."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSection 12 prerequisites passed:",
  sum(image_available),
  "of",
  length(expected_keys),
  "composites available.\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.2. Define output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    plot_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.3. Validate schedule and availability keys
# ---------------------------------------------------------

required_schedule_columns <- c(
  "year", "window", "season", "key",
  "target_start", "target_end",
  "expanded_start", "expanded_end"
)

required_availability_columns <- c(
  "key", "scene_count",
  "valid_pixel_coverage_pct",
  "coverage_status"
)

missing_schedule_columns <- setdiff(
  required_schedule_columns,
  names(window_schedule)
)

missing_availability_columns <- setdiff(
  required_availability_columns,
  names(availability_summary)
)

if (length(missing_schedule_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in window_schedule: ",
    paste(missing_schedule_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(missing_availability_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in availability_summary: ",
    paste(missing_availability_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(window_schedule$key)) {
  stop("Duplicate keys detected in window_schedule.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(availability_summary$key)) {
  stop("Duplicate keys detected in availability_summary.")
}

if (nrow(window_schedule) != 16) {
  stop(
    "Expected 16 year-window combinations, found ",
    nrow(window_schedule), "."
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.4. Rebuild clean source tables
# Avoid .x and .y duplicate columns
# ---------------------------------------------------------

schedule_clean <- window_schedule %>%
  select(all_of(required_schedule_columns))

availability_clean <- availability_summary %>%
  select(all_of(required_availability_columns))

# Confirm every scheduled window has availability metadata
missing_availability_keys <- setdiff(
  schedule_clean$key,
  availability_clean$key
)

if (length(missing_availability_keys) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Availability information is missing for: ",
    paste(missing_availability_keys, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.5. Match existing Earth Engine composites
# IMPORTANT: use seasonal_composites directly
# ---------------------------------------------------------

composite_keys <- names(seasonal_composites)

if (is.null(composite_keys)) {
  stop(
    "seasonal_composites must be a named list ",
    "with window keys as names."
  )
}

image_available <- vapply(
  schedule_clean$key,
  function(k) {
    if (!k %in% composite_keys) {
      return(FALSE)
    }

    !is.null(seasonal_composites[[k]])
  },
  logical(1)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.6. Construct the final selection manifest
# ---------------------------------------------------------

final_selection <- schedule_clean %>%
  left_join(
    availability_clean,
    by = "key"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    image_available = image_available,

    selected_source = if_else(
      image_available,
      "expanded_window_composite",
      "none"
    ),

    selection_status = case_when(
      !image_available ~ "image_unavailable",

      is.na(scene_count) | scene_count < 1 ~
        "review_required_no_scenes",

      is.na(valid_pixel_coverage_pct) ~
        "review_required_missing_coverage",

      is.na(coverage_status) |
        coverage_status != "adequate_coverage" ~
        "review_required_coverage",

      TRUE ~ "provisional_expanded_composite"
    ),

    selection_notes = paste(
      "Uses the expanded date window;",
      "not restricted to the exact target dates.",
      "Spatial coverage does not establish",
      "land-cover classification accuracy."
    )
  )

# The subsequent QC, mapping and spectral sections use selected_composites.
# At this stage the workflow selects available expanded-window composites;
# the status columns continue to flag composites requiring manual review.
selected_keys <- final_selection$key[final_selection$image_available]
selected_composites <- seasonal_composites[selected_keys]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.7. Run validation checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  nrow(final_selection) == 16,
  !anyDuplicated(final_selection$key),
  all(final_selection$key %in% schedule_clean$key),
  setequal(final_selection$key, schedule_clean$key)
)

# Report image availability
n_images_available <- sum(
  final_selection$image_available,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\nCOMPOSITE SELECTION VALIDATION\n",
  "----------------------------------------\n",
  "Scheduled windows: ", nrow(final_selection), "\n",
  "Images available:  ", n_images_available, "\n",
  "Images missing:    ",
  sum(!final_selection$image_available), "\n",
  "Unique window keys: ",
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_selection$key), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.8. Print the complete selection manifest
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print(
  final_selection %>%
    select(
      year, window, key,
      target_start, target_end,
      expanded_start, expanded_end,
      scene_count,
      valid_pixel_coverage_pct,
      coverage_status,
      selected_source,
      selection_status,
      image_available
    ) %>%
    arrange(year, window),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.9. Save the manifest
# ---------------------------------------------------------

manifest_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Final_Selection_Manifest.csv"
)

write.csv(
  final_selection,
  manifest_file,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.10. Save a diagnostic summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

selection_summary <- final_selection %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    selection_status,
    coverage_status
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_windows = n(),

    images_available = sum(
      image_available,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    minimum_coverage_pct = if (
      all(is.na(valid_pixel_coverage_pct))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      min(
        valid_pixel_coverage_pct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    maximum_coverage_pct = if (
      all(is.na(valid_pixel_coverage_pct))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      max(
        valid_pixel_coverage_pct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Selection_Diagnostic_Summary.csv"
)

write.csv(
  selection_summary,
  summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12.11. Final confirmation
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nSECTION 12 COMPLETED\n",
  "----------------------------------------\n",
  "Manifest: ",
  normalizePath(
    manifest_file,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  ), "\n",
  "Diagnostic summary: ",
  normalizePath(
    summary_file,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  ), "\n",
  "----------------------------------------\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (
  all(final_selection$image_available) &&
  all(
    final_selection$selection_status ==
      "provisional_expanded_composite"
  )
) {
  message(
    "SUCCESS: All 16 windows have available ",
    "expanded-window composites and passed ",
    "the current coverage-status checks."
  )
} else {
  warning(
    "Some windows require review. ",
    "Check selection_status in final_selection."
  )
}
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 13A: VISUAL QUALITY CONTROL
# =========================================================

library(rgee)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# Centre the interactive map on Tharaka Sub-county.
Map$centerObject(roi, 10)

# Add the ROI boundary for orientation.
Map$addLayer(
  roi,
  list(color = "yellow"),
  name = "Tharaka ROI"
)

for (key in names(selected_composites)) {

  image <- selected_composites[[key]]

  if (is.null(image)) {
    message("Skipping unavailable composite: ", key)
    next
  }

  message("Adding visual QC layers: ", key)

  # True-colour RGB: red, green, blue.
  Map$addLayer(
    image,
    list(
      bands = c("red", "green", "blue"),
      min = 0,
      max = 0.30,
      gamma = 1.2
    ),
    name = paste0(key, "_RGB"),
    shown = FALSE
  )

  # False colour: near infrared, red, green.
  Map$addLayer(
    image,
    list(
      bands = c("nir", "red", "green"),
      min = 0,
      max = 0.40,
      gamma = 1.2
    ),
    name = paste0(key, "_FalseColour"),
    shown = FALSE
  )

  # NDVI: vegetation contrast.
  ndvi <- image$
    normalizedDifference(c("nir", "red"))$
    rename("NDVI")

  Map$addLayer(
    ndvi,
    list(
      min = -0.2,
      max = 0.8,
      palette = c("8c510a", "f6e8c3", "80cdc1", "01665e")
    ),
    name = paste0(key, "_NDVI"),
    shown = FALSE
  )
}

cat(
  "Visual QC layers added. Use the map layer selector to inspect ",
  "each year and season.\n"
)
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 13B: SPECTRAL QUALITY-CONTROL SUMMARY
# =========================================================

get_spectral_summary <- function(key, image, source) {

  if (is.null(image)) {
    return(tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = NA_real_,
      mean_blue = NA_real_,
      mean_green = NA_real_,
      mean_red = NA_real_,
      mean_nir = NA_real_,
      mean_swir1 = NA_real_,
      mean_swir2 = NA_real_,
      qc_status = "no_composite"
    ))
  }

  stats <- tryCatch({

    ndvi <- image$
      normalizedDifference(c("nir", "red"))$
      rename("NDVI")

    combined <- image$select(
      c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
    )$addBands(ndvi)

    result <- combined$reduceRegion(
      reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 30,
      maxPixels = 1e10,
      tileScale = 4
    )$getInfo()

    result <- reticulate::py_to_r(result)

    get_stat <- function(name) {
      value <- result[[name]]
      if (is.null(value)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(value)
    }

    tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = get_stat("NDVI"),
      mean_blue = get_stat("blue"),
      mean_green = get_stat("green"),
      mean_red = get_stat("red"),
      mean_nir = get_stat("nir"),
      mean_swir1 = get_stat("swir1"),
      mean_swir2 = get_stat("swir2"),
      qc_status = "summary_calculated"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Spectral summary failed for ", key, ": ",
            conditionMessage(e))

    tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = NA_real_,
      mean_blue = NA_real_,
      mean_green = NA_real_,
      mean_red = NA_real_,
      mean_nir = NA_real_,
      mean_swir1 = NA_real_,
      mean_swir2 = NA_real_,
      qc_status = "summary_failed"
    )
  })

  stats
}

spectral_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(selected_composites), function(key) {

    source <- final_selection$selected_source[
      match(key, final_selection$key)
    ]

    get_spectral_summary(
      key = key,
      image = selected_composites[[key]],
      source = source
    )
  })
) %>%
  left_join(
    final_selection %>% select(key, year, window),
    by = "key"
  ) %>%
  select(
    year, window, key, source,
    mean_ndvi, mean_blue, mean_green, mean_red,
    mean_nir, mean_swir1, mean_swir2, qc_status
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, window)

print(spectral_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  spectral_summary,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Spectral_QC.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 13C: CORRECTED NDVI AND SEASONAL COMPARISONS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

get_spectral_summary_v2 <- function(key, image, source) {

  if (is.null(image)) {
    return(tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = NA_real_,
      mean_blue = NA_real_,
      mean_green = NA_real_,
      mean_red = NA_real_,
      mean_nir = NA_real_,
      mean_swir1 = NA_real_,
      mean_swir2 = NA_real_,
      qc_status = "no_composite"
    ))
  }

  tryCatch({

    nir <- image$select("nir")
    red <- image$select("red")

    denominator <- nir$add(red)

    # Explicit NDVI calculation; mask only zero denominators.
    ndvi <- nir$subtract(red)$
      divide(denominator)$
      updateMask(denominator$neq(0))$
      rename("NDVI")

    combined <- image$select(
      c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
    )$addBands(ndvi)

    result <- combined$reduceRegion(
      reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 30,
      maxPixels = 1e10,
      tileScale = 4
    )$getInfo()

    result <- reticulate::py_to_r(result)

    get_stat <- function(name) {
      value <- result[[name]]
      if (is.null(value)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(value)
    }

    tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = get_stat("NDVI"),
      mean_blue = get_stat("blue"),
      mean_green = get_stat("green"),
      mean_red = get_stat("red"),
      mean_nir = get_stat("nir"),
      mean_swir1 = get_stat("swir1"),
      mean_swir2 = get_stat("swir2"),
      qc_status = "summary_calculated"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    message("Corrected summary failed for ", key, ": ",
            conditionMessage(e))

    tibble(
      key = key,
      source = source,
      mean_ndvi = NA_real_,
      mean_blue = NA_real_,
      mean_green = NA_real_,
      mean_red = NA_real_,
      mean_nir = NA_real_,
      mean_swir1 = NA_real_,
      mean_swir2 = NA_real_,
      qc_status = "summary_failed"
    )
  })
}


spectral_summary_v2 <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(selected_composites), function(key) {

    source <- final_selection$selected_source[
      match(key, final_selection$key)
    ]

    get_spectral_summary_v2(
      key = key,
      image = selected_composites[[key]],
      source = source
    )
  })
) %>%
  left_join(
    final_selection %>% select(key, year, window),
    by = "key"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      grepl("dry", window) ~ "Dry",
      grepl("wet", window) ~ "Wet",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    year, window, season, key, source,
    mean_ndvi, mean_blue, mean_green, mean_red,
    mean_nir, mean_swir1, mean_swir2, qc_status
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, match(window, windows$window))

print(spectral_summary_v2, n = Inf, width = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  spectral_summary_v2,
  "Tharaka_Landsat_Spectral_QC_Corrected.csv"
)


# Plot mean NDVI by year and seasonal window.
p_ndvi <- ggplot(
  spectral_summary_v2,
  aes(
    x = factor(year),
    y = mean_ndvi,
    group = window,

  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +

    title = "Tharaka Sub-county: Seasonal Mean NDVI",
    subtitle = "Corrected NDVI calculation; provisional composites",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean NDVI",
    linetype = "Seasonal window"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_ndvi)

ggsave(

# Plot the six reflectance bands as a compact diagnostic.
reflectance_long <- spectral_summary_v2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      mean_blue, mean_green, mean_red,
      mean_nir, mean_swir1, mean_swir2
    ),
    names_to = "band",

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    band = recode(
      band,
      mean_blue = "Blue",

  )

p_reflectance <- ggplot(

) +
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 14: REFERENCE-SAMPLING FRAMEWORK
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14.1 Sampling settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------

n_candidates <- 500
sampling_seed <- 2026

# Confirm that roi is the intended Tharaka Sub-county boundary
stopifnot(!is.null(roi))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14.2 Generate random candidate locations in the ROI
# ---------------------------------------------------------

candidate_points <- ee$FeatureCollection$randomPoints(
  region = roi,
  points = n_candidates,
  seed = sampling_seed,
  maxError = 30
)

# Attach an identifier and geographic coordinates.
coordinate_callback <- reticulate::py_eval(
  paste0(
    "lambda f: f.set({",
    "'point_id': f.get('system:index'),",
    "'longitude': f.geometry().coordinates().get(0),",
    "'latitude': f.geometry().coordinates().get(1)",
    "})"
  ),
  convert = FALSE
)

candidate_points <- ee_method(
  candidate_points, "map", coordinate_callback
)

# Retrieve the coordinates as ordinary R vectors.
point_ids <- ee_get_info(
  ee_method(candidate_points, "aggregate_array", "point_id")
)

longitudes <- ee_get_info(
  ee_method(candidate_points, "aggregate_array", "longitude")
)

latitudes <- ee_get_info(
  ee_method(candidate_points, "aggregate_array", "latitude")
)

reference_points <- tibble(
  point_id = as.character(unlist(point_ids)),
  longitude = as.numeric(unlist(longitudes)),
  latitude = as.numeric(unlist(latitudes))
) %>%
  arrange(point_id)

stopifnot(nrow(reference_points) > 0)

cat("Candidate points generated:", nrow(reference_points), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14.3 Create a manual reference-label template
# ---------------------------------------------------------

reference_template <- reference_points

study_years <- c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2025)

for (yr in study_years) {
  reference_template[[paste0("class_", yr)]] <- NA_character_
  reference_template[[paste0("confidence_", yr)]] <- NA_character_
  reference_template[[paste0("evidence_", yr)]] <- NA_character_
  reference_template[[paste0("notes_", yr)]] <- NA_character_
}

reference_template <- reference_template %>%
  mutate(
    class_2000 = as.character(class_2000),
    class_2010 = as.character(class_2010),
    class_2020 = as.character(class_2020),
    class_2025 = as.character(class_2025)
  )

readr::write_csv(
  reference_template,
  "Tharaka_Reference_Sampling_Template.csv"
)

# Save the unlabelled coordinates separately as well.
readr::write_csv(
  reference_points,
  "Tharaka_Reference_Candidate_Points.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14.4 Optional: display candidate locations in the map
# ---------------------------------------------------------

Map$centerObject(roi, 10)

Map$addLayer(
  candidate_points,
  list(color = "cyan"),
  name = "Reference candidate points",
  shown = TRUE
)

print(head(reference_template, 10))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 17.1: INTERACTIVE HISTORICAL IMAGERY MAP
# =========================================================

library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(reticulate)

# Confirm the required objects exist
stopifnot(
  exists("ee"),
  exists("selected_composites"),
  exists("pilot_reference")
)

stopifnot(nrow(pilot_reference) > 0)

# Convert pilot coordinates to an sf object
pilot_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pilot_reference,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Visualisation parameters for Landsat surface reflectance
vis_params <- list(
  bands = list("red", "green", "blue"),
  min = 0.0,
  max = 0.30,
  gamma = 1.2
)

# Obtain Earth Engine tile URLs for each selected composite
composite_names <- names(selected_composites)

if (is.null(composite_names) || length(composite_names) == 0) {
  stop("selected_composites must be a named list of images.")
}

tile_urls <- list()

for (nm in composite_names) {

  img <- selected_composites[[nm]]

  map_info <- ee_method(
    img,
    "getMapId",
    vis_params
  )

  tile_fetcher <- map_info[["tile_fetcher"]]

  tile_url <- reticulate::py_to_r(
    reticulate::py_get_attr(
      tile_fetcher,
      "url_format"
    )
  )

  tile_urls[[nm]] <- tile_url
}

# Build the interactive map
m <- leaflet(
  options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)
) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron", group = "Base map") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = pilot_sf,
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 4,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste0("Point ", point_id),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Point ID:</b> ", point_id,
      "<br><b>Longitude:</b> ", round(longitude, 5),
      "<br><b>Latitude:</b> ", round(latitude, 5)
    ),
    group = "Pilot points"
  )

# Add each composite as a switchable imagery layer
for (nm in names(tile_urls)) {
  m <- m %>%
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = tile_urls[[nm]],
      group = nm,
      options = tileOptions(opacity = 1)
    )
}

# Add layer controls
m <- m %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = "Base map",
    overlayGroups = c("Pilot points", names(tile_urls)),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  hideGroup(names(tile_urls)) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(pilot_reference$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    lat1 = min(pilot_reference$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    lng2 = max(pilot_reference$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    lat2 = max(pilot_reference$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Display in RStudio Viewer
m

# Save the interactive map
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  m,
  "Tharaka_Historical_Imagery_Review.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 18: REFERENCE-LABEL VALIDATION
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# Read the reviewed worksheet
reference_file <- "Tharaka_Historical_Reference_Review.csv"

reference_review <- read_csv(
  reference_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Allowed values
allowed_years <- c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2025)

allowed_classes <- c(
  "forest", "grassland", "bushland", "farmland",
  "settlement", "other", "uncertain"
)

allowed_confidence <- c("high", "medium", "low")

allowed_evidence <- c(
  "historical_imagery", "existing_map",
  "field", "other"
)

# Standardise text without assigning any labels
reference_review <- reference_review %>%
  mutate(
    point_id = as.character(point_id),
    year = as.integer(year),
    land_cover = tolower(trimws(land_cover)),
    confidence = tolower(trimws(confidence)),
    evidence = tolower(trimws(evidence)),
    notes = trimws(notes)
  )

# Identify invalid values and missing entries
reference_review <- reference_review %>%
  mutate(
    invalid_year = is.na(year) | !year %in% allowed_years,

    missing_class = is.na(land_cover) | land_cover == "",

    invalid_class = !missing_class &
      !land_cover %in% allowed_classes,

    missing_confidence = is.na(confidence) | confidence == "",

    invalid_confidence = !missing_confidence &
      !confidence %in% allowed_confidence,

    missing_evidence = is.na(evidence) | evidence == "",

    invalid_evidence = !missing_evidence &
      !evidence %in% allowed_evidence,

    needs_review =
      invalid_year |
      missing_class |
      invalid_class |
      missing_confidence |
      invalid_confidence |
      missing_evidence |
      invalid_evidence |
      land_cover == "uncertain" |
      confidence == "low"
  )

# Summary of the validation
validation_summary <- reference_review %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    unique_points = n_distinct(point_id),
    missing_classes = sum(missing_class),
    invalid_classes = sum(invalid_class),
    missing_confidence = sum(missing_confidence),
    invalid_confidence = sum(invalid_confidence),
    missing_evidence = sum(missing_evidence),
    invalid_evidence = sum(invalid_evidence),
    records_needing_review = sum(needs_review)
  )

print(validation_summary)

# Label counts by year
class_counts <- reference_review %>%
  filter(
    !missing_class,
    !invalid_class,
    land_cover != "uncertain"
  ) %>%
  count(year, land_cover, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(year, land_cover)

print(class_counts)

# Export all records needing attention
review_flags <- reference_review %>%
  filter(needs_review)

write_csv(
  review_flags,
  "Tharaka_Reference_Review_Flags.csv"
)

# Export the validation summary and class counts
write_csv(
  validation_summary,
  "Tharaka_Reference_Validation_Summary.csv"
)

write_csv(
  class_counts,
  "Tharaka_Reference_Class_Counts.csv"
)

cat("Validation completed.\n")
cat("Records flagged for review:", nrow(review_flags), "\n")
```

```{r}
  arrange(year, point_id)

# Create workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Labelling_Sheet")
addWorksheet(wb, "Progress_Summary")
addWorksheet(wb, "Instructions")

# Write the labelling sheet
writeData(
  wb, "Labelling_Sheet",
  labelling_sheet,
  withFilter = TRUE
)

# Add drop-down validation lists
class_values <- c(
  "forest", "grassland", "bushland", "farmland",
  "settlement", "other", "uncertain"
)

confidence_values <- c("high", "medium", "low")

evidence_values <- c(
  "historical_imagery", "existing_map",
  "field", "other"
)

n_rows <- nrow(labelling_sheet) + 1

dataValidation(
  wb, "Labelling_Sheet",
  cols = 5, rows = 2:n_rows,
  type = "list",
  value = paste0('"', paste(class_values, collapse = ","), '"')
)

dataValidation(
  wb, "Labelling_Sheet",
  cols = 6, rows = 2:n_rows,
  type = "list",
  value = paste0('"', paste(confidence_values, collapse = ","), '"')
)

dataValidation(
  wb, "Labelling_Sheet",
  cols = 7, rows = 2:n_rows,
  type = "list",
  value = paste0('"', paste(evidence_values, collapse = ","), '"')
)

# Instructions sheet
instructions <- data.frame(
  Item = c(
    "Purpose",
    "Land-cover classes",
    "Confidence",
    "Evidence",
    "Uncertain labels",
    "Important"
  ),
  Guidance = c(
    "Interpret each point separately for each target year.",
    paste(class_values, collapse = ", "),
    paste(confidence_values, collapse = ", "),
    paste(evidence_values, collapse = ", "),
    "Use uncertain when evidence does not support a confident class.",
    "Do not guess labels. Record the evidence and relevant notes."
  )
)

writeData(wb, "Instructions", instructions)

# Create progress summary formulas
progress <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2025),
  Total_Records = 50,
  Labelled = NA_integer_,
  Remaining = NA_integer_
)

writeData(wb, "Progress_Summary", progress)

for (i in 2:5) {
  wb_formula_row <- i
  wb_sheet_start <- 2
  wb_sheet_end <- n_rows

  writeFormula(
    wb,
    "Progress_Summary",
    x = sprintf(
      'COUNTIFS(Labelling_Sheet!$D$%d:$D$%d,A%d,Labelling_Sheet!$E$%d:$E$%d,"<>")',
      wb_sheet_start, wb_sheet_end, wb_formula_row,
      wb_sheet_start, wb_sheet_end
    ),
    startCol = 3,
    startRow = wb_formula_row
  )

  writeFormula(
    wb,
    "Progress_Summary",
    x = sprintf("B%d-C%d", wb_formula_row, wb_formula_row),
    startCol = 4,
    startRow = wb_formula_row
  )
}

# Formatting
header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill = "#D9EAF7",
  border = "Bottom"
)

for (sheet in c(
  "Labelling_Sheet",
  "Progress_Summary",
  "Instructions"
)) {
  addStyle(
    wb, sheet, header_style,
    rows = 1, cols = 1:8,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 1:8, widths = "auto")
}

# Save workbook
output_file <- "Tharaka_Reference_Labelling_Workbook_Template.xlsx"

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  output_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Workbook created:", output_file, "\n")

```

```{r}


# =========================================================
# SECTION 23: EXTRACT PILOT-POINT SPECTRAL INDICATORS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 23.1 Confirm required objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  exists("ee"),
  exists("selected_composites"),
  exists("pilot_reference"),
  exists("ee_method"),
  exists("ee_get_info")
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(pilot_reference) > 0,
  length(selected_composites) > 0
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 23.2 Create Earth Engine point features
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pilot_features <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(pilot_reference)),
  function(i) {

    lon <- as.numeric(pilot_reference$longitude[i])
    lat <- as.numeric(pilot_reference$latitude[i])
    pid <- as.character(pilot_reference$point_id[i])

    geometry <- ee$Geometry$Point(
      reticulate::tuple(lon, lat)
    )

    ee$Feature(
      geometry,
      list(
        point_id = pid,
        longitude = lon,
        latitude = lat
      )
    )
  }
)

# Build the FeatureCollection using a Python list
pilot_list <- reticulate::r_to_py(
  pilot_features,
  convert = FALSE
)

pilot_fc <- ee$FeatureCollection(pilot_list)

cat(
  "Pilot locations prepared:",
  nrow(pilot_reference), "\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 23.3 Define output containers
# ---------------------------------------------------------

spectral_results <- list()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 23.4 Sample each selected composite
# ---------------------------------------------------------

for (nm in names(selected_composites)) {

  cat("Processing composite:", nm, "\n")

  img <- selected_composites[[nm]]

  # Calculate NDVI.
  # IMPORTANT: pass band names as a flat character vector.
  ndvi <- ee_method(
    img,
    "normalizedDifference",
    c("nir", "red")
  )

  ndvi <- ee_method(
    ndvi,
    "rename",
    "NDVI"
  )

  # Add NDVI to the six reflectance bands
  img_with_ndvi <- ee_method(
    img,
    "addBands",
    ndvi
  )

  # Sample the image at each point
  sampled <- ee_method(
    img_with_ndvi,
    "sampleRegions",
    collection = pilot_fc,
    properties = reticulate::tuple(
      "point_id", "longitude", "latitude"
    ),
    scale = 30,
    geometries = FALSE,
    tileScale = 4
  )

  # Retrieve sampled records from Earth Engine
  sampled_info <- ee_get_info(sampled)

  # Convert the feature properties to an R data frame
  if (
    is.null(sampled_info$features) ||
    length(sampled_info$features) == 0
  ) {
    warning(
      "No sampled records returned for composite: ",
      nm
    )
    next
  }

  feature_rows <- lapply(
    sampled_info$features,
    function(f) {

      props <- f$properties

      # Convert each property list into a one-row data frame
      as.data.frame(
        lapply(props, function(x) {
          if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
            NA
          } else {
            unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)[1]
          }
        }),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  result <- bind_rows(feature_rows) %>%
    mutate(
      composite = nm,
      year = as.integer(
        sub("_.*$", "", nm)
      )
    )

  spectral_results[[nm]] <- result

  cat(
    "  Sampled records:",
    nrow(result), "\n"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 23.5 Combine, inspect and export results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (length(spectral_results) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No spectral data were returned. Check the selected ",
    "composites, band names and Earth Engine errors."
  )

}

pilot_spectral_data <- bind_rows(spectral_results)

# Reorder important identifier columns first
pilot_spectral_data <- pilot_spectral_data %>%
  relocate(
    composite,
    year,
    point_id,
    longitude,
    latitude
  )

# Summarise extraction coverage
spectral_qc <- pilot_spectral_data %>%
  group_by(composite, year) %>%
  summarise(
    records_returned = n(),
    unique_points = n_distinct(point_id),
    missing_NDVI = sum(is.na(NDVI)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(spectral_qc)
print(head(pilot_spectral_data, 10))

# Export data and QC report
write_csv(
  pilot_spectral_data,
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Spectral_Indicators.csv"
)

write_csv(
  spectral_qc,
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Spectral_QC.csv"
)

cat(
  "Spectral extraction complete.\n",
  "Total sampled records: ",
  nrow(pilot_spectral_data), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 24: SPECTRAL EXTRACTION COMPLETENESS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# Expected combinations: every pilot point in every composite
expected_records <- pilot_reference %>%
  transmute(
    point_id = as.character(point_id),
    longitude,
    latitude
  ) %>%
  crossing(composite = names(selected_composites)) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(sub("_.*$", "", composite))
  )

# Compare expected combinations with actual extracted records
observed_records <- pilot_spectral_data %>%
  distinct(point_id, composite) %>%
  mutate(point_id = as.character(point_id))

missing_spectral_records <- expected_records %>%
  anti_join(
    observed_records,
    by = c("point_id", "composite")
  ) %>%
  arrange(composite, point_id)

# Completeness summary
completeness_summary <- expected_records %>%
  left_join(
    observed_records %>%
      mutate(returned = TRUE),
    by = c("point_id", "composite")
  ) %>%
  group_by(composite, year) %>%
  summarise(
    expected = n(),
    returned = sum(!is.na(returned)),
    missing = expected - returned,
    completeness_pct = round(100 * returned / expected, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(completeness_summary)
print(missing_spectral_records)

write_csv(
  completeness_summary,
  "Tharaka_Spectral_Completeness.csv"
)

write_csv(
  missing_spectral_records,
  "Tharaka_Missing_Spectral_Records.csv"
)
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 25: CALCULATE ADDITIONAL SPECTRAL INDICES
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

pilot_spectral_indices <- pilot_spectral_data %>%
  mutate(
    NDMI = if_else(
      is.finite(nir + swir1) & (nir + swir1) != 0,
      (nir - swir1) / (nir + swir1),
      NA_real_
    ),

    NDBI = if_else(
      is.finite(swir1 + nir) & (swir1 + nir) != 0,
      (swir1 - nir) / (swir1 + nir),
      NA_real_
    ),

    SAVI = if_else(
      is.finite(nir + red + 0.5) &
        (nir + red + 0.5) != 0,
      1.5 * (nir - red) / (nir + red + 0.5),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Check index ranges and missing values
index_qc <- pilot_spectral_indices %>%
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    missing_NDVI = sum(is.na(NDVI)),
    missing_NDMI = sum(is.na(NDMI)),
    missing_NDBI = sum(is.na(NDBI)),
    missing_SAVI = sum(is.na(SAVI)),
    max_abs_NDMI_NDBI_difference = max(
      abs(NDMI + NDBI),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

print(index_qc)

# Summarise indicators by year and seasonal window
index_summary <- pilot_spectral_indices %>%
  group_by(composite, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_NDVI = mean(NDVI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_NDMI = mean(NDMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_NDBI = mean(NDBI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SAVI = mean(SAVI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(index_summary)

# Export indices and summary
write_csv(
  pilot_spectral_indices,
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Spectral_Indices.csv"
)

write_csv(
  index_summary,
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Spectral_Index_Summary.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 26: VISUALISE SPECTRAL INDEX PATTERNS
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# Create season labels from composite names
index_plot_data <- pilot_spectral_indices %>%
  mutate(
    season_window = sub("^\\d{4}_", "", composite),
    season = case_when(
      grepl("^dry_", season_window) ~ "Dry",
      grepl("^wet_", season_window) ~ "Wet",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    month_window = sub("^(dry|wet)_", "", season_window)
  )

# Plot 1: Mean NDVI by year and seasonal window
p_ndvi <- index_plot_data %>%
  group_by(year, season_window) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_NDVI = mean(NDVI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_NDVI = sd(NDVI, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_NDVI = sd_NDVI / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = mean_NDVI,
      colour = season_window,
      group = season_window
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2025)) +
  labs(
    title = "Pilot-Point Mean NDVI by Year and Seasonal Window",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean NDVI",
    colour = "Window"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_ndvi)

ggsave(
  "Tharaka_Pilot_NDVI_Trends.png",
  p_ndvi,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

# Plot 2: Compare all index distributions
index_long <- index_plot_data %>%
  select(
    year, season_window, NDVI, NDMI, SAVI
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NDVI, NDMI, SAVI),
    names_to = "index",
    values_to = "value"
  )

p_indices <- ggplot(
  index_long,
  aes(
    x = factor(year),
    y = value,
    group = interaction(year, season_window)
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = season_window), outlier.size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ index, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Spectral Index Distributions at Pilot Locations",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Index value",
    fill = "Window"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

print(p_indices)

ggsave(
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Index_Distributions.png",
  p_indices,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("Section 26 plots saved successfully.\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 30: PREPARE PILOT REFERENCE-LABELING SHEET
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

pilot_label_sheet <- reference_review %>%
  select(
    point_id,
    year,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    land_cover,
    confidence,
    evidence,
    notes
  ) %>%
  arrange(point_id, year)

# Export a CSV for manual labeling
write_csv(
  pilot_label_sheet,
  "Tharaka_Pilot_Reference_Labelling.csv"
)

# Show labeling requirements
cat("Records requiring review:", nrow(pilot_label_sheet), "\n")
cat("Unique locations:", n_distinct(pilot_label_sheet$point_id), "\n")

                    collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 32: GENERATE ALL 16 LANDSAT SCENARIO PLOTS
# =========================================================

library(reticulate)
library(ggplot2)
library(png)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Earth Engine session
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)

# Reuse the working Earth Engine authentication
ee$Initialize(project = "thinking-leaf-305215")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Output directory and scenario labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Scenario_Plots"

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

scenario_labels <- c(
  dry_feb = "February Dry Season",
  dry_sep = "September Dry Season",
  wet_may = "May Wet Season",
  wet_dec = "December Wet Season"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Confirm the 16 composites are available
# ---------------------------------------------------------
scenario_names <- names(selected_composites)

if (length(scenario_names) != 16) {
  stop(
    "Expected 16 composites, but found ",
    length(scenario_names),
    ". Check selected_composites."
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot each scenario
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_results <- data.frame(
  composite = scenario_names,
  status = "Pending",
  file = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(scenario_names)) {

  scenario <- scenario_names[i]

  message(
    "\nProcessing scenario ",
    i, " of ", length(scenario_names),
    ": ", scenario
  )

  tryCatch({

    # Retrieve existing Earth Engine image
    img <- selected_composites[[scenario]]

    # Create true-colour visualisation in Earth Engine
    visualized_img <- ee$Image$visualize(
      img,
      bands = c("red", "green", "blue"),
      min = 0.02,
      max = 0.30,
      gamma = 1.3
    )

    # Request thumbnail URL
    thumb <- visualized_img$getThumbURL(
      reticulate::dict(
        region = roi,
        dimensions = 1200,
        format = "png"
      )
    )

    thumb_url <- reticulate::py_to_r(thumb)

    # Download thumbnail to a temporary PNG
    temp_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

    download.file(
      url = thumb_url,
      destfile = temp_png,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    # Read the image
    raster_img <- png::readPNG(temp_png)

    # Extract year and seasonal window
    year <- sub("_.*$", "", scenario)
    window <- sub("^\\d{4}_", "", scenario)

    if (!window %in% names(scenario_labels)) {
      stop("Unrecognised seasonal window: ", window)
    }

    # Create title
    title_text <- paste(
      "Tharaka Sub-county —",
      scenario_labels[[window]],
      year
    )

    # Construct framed figure
    p <- ggplot() +
      annotation_raster(
        raster_img,
        xmin = 0, xmax = 1,
        ymin = 0, ymax = 1
      ) +
      coord_fixed(
        xlim = c(0, 1),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        expand = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = title_text,
        subtitle = paste(
          "Landsat Collection 2 Level-2",
          "| True-colour RGB composite"
        ),
        caption = paste(
          "Display stretch: RGB bands,",
          "min = 0.02, max = 0.30, gamma = 1.3"
        )
      ) +
      theme_void(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 15,
          hjust = 0.5,
          margin = margin(b = 8)
        ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
          size = 10,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.caption = element_text(
          size = 8,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        panel.border = element_rect(
          colour = "black",
          fill = NA,
          linewidth = 0.9
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
      )

    # Save plot
    output_file <- file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("Tharaka_", scenario, ".png")
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = output_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 9,
      height = 7,
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )

    # Record success
    plot_results$status[i] <- "Success"
    plot_results$file[i] <- output_file

    unlink(temp_png)

    message("Saved: ", output_file)

  }, error = function(e) {

    plot_results$status[i] <<- paste(
      "Failed:", conditionMessage(e)
    )

    message(
      "Failed for ", scenario, ": ",
      conditionMessage(e)
    )
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save processing log
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(
  plot_results,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Scenario_Plot_Processing_Log.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("SECTION 32 FINISHED\n")
cat("Successful plots:",
    sum(plot_results$status == "Success"), "\n")
cat("Failed plots:",
    sum(plot_results$status != "Success"), "\n")
cat("Output folder:",
    normalizePath(plot_dir), "\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(plot_results)
```
