```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 32: PUBLICATION-STYLE LANDSAT SCENARIO MAPS
# =========================================================

library(reticulate)
library(ggplot2)
library(png)
library(grid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Earth Engine session and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)
ee$Initialize(project = "thinking-leaf-305215")

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Seasonal labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

scenario_labels <- c(
  dry_feb = "February Dry Season (10–20 February)",
  dry_sep = "September Dry Season (15–25 September)",
  wet_may = "May Wet Season (5–30 May)",
  wet_dec = "December Wet Season (5–30 December)"
)

scenario_names <- names(selected_composites)

if (length(scenario_names) != 16) {
  stop("Expected 16 scenarios; found ",
       length(scenario_names), ".")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Processing log
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_results <- data.frame(
  composite = scenario_names,
  status = "Pending",
  file = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate enhanced maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

for (i in seq_along(scenario_names)) {

  scenario <- scenario_names[i]

  message(
    "\nProcessing ", i, " of ",
    length(scenario_names), ": ", scenario
  )

  temp_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  tryCatch({

    img <- selected_composites[[scenario]]

    year <- sub("_.*$", "", scenario)
    window <- sub("^\\d{4}_", "", scenario)

    if (!window %in% names(scenario_labels)) {
      stop("Unknown seasonal window: ", window)
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # A. True-colour RGB visualisation
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    # Estimate robust per-band display limits from the 2nd and 98th
    # reflectance percentiles. This improves contrast across bright and
    # dark scenes without changing the underlying reflectance values.
    rgb_stats_image <- ee_method(
      img, "select", c("red", "green", "blue")
    )

    rgb_stats <- ee_get_info(ee_method(
      rgb_stats_image, "reduceRegion",
      reducer = ee$Reducer$percentile(c(2, 98)),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 90,
      maxPixels = 1e9,
      bestEffort = TRUE,
      tileScale = 4
    ))

    get_rgb_percentile <- function(band, percentile, fallback) {
      key <- paste0(band, "_p", percentile)
      value <- rgb_stats[[key]]
      if (is.null(value) || length(value) != 1L ||
          !is.finite(as.numeric(value))) {
        return(fallback)
      }
      as.numeric(value)
    }

    rgb_min <- c(
      get_rgb_percentile("red", 2, 0.02),
      get_rgb_percentile("green", 2, 0.02),
      get_rgb_percentile("blue", 2, 0.02)
    )
    rgb_max <- c(
      get_rgb_percentile("red", 98, 0.30),
      get_rgb_percentile("green", 98, 0.30),
      get_rgb_percentile("blue", 98, 0.30)
    )

    # Guard against flat or degenerate percentile ranges.
    rgb_max <- pmax(rgb_max, rgb_min + 0.03)

    rgb_img <- ee$Image$visualize(
      img,
      bands = c("red", "green", "blue"),
      min = rgb_min,
      max = rgb_max,
      gamma = 1.15
    )

   # -----------------------------------------------------
# B. Add ONLY the ROI boundary, keeping the image visible
# -----------------------------------------------------

roi_fc <- ee$FeatureCollection(
  ee$Feature(roi)
)

# Paint the boundary into a blank image
boundary_img <- ee$Image$constant(0)$byte()$paint(
  roi_fc, 1, 2
)

# Mask out all pixels except the painted boundary
boundary_masked <- boundary_img$updateMask(
  boundary_img
)

# Visualise the boundary in white
boundary_vis <- boundary_masked$visualize(
  palette = c("FFFFFF"),
  min = 0,
  max = 1,
  opacity = 1
)

# Overlay the boundary without covering the RGB imagery
map_img <- rgb_img$blend(boundary_vis)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # C. Download thumbnail
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    thumb <- map_img$getThumbURL(
      reticulate::dict(
        region = roi,
        dimensions = 1200,
        format = "png"
      )
    )

    thumb_url <- reticulate::py_to_r(thumb)

    download.file(
      url = thumb_url,
      destfile = temp_png,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    raster_img <- png::readPNG(temp_png)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # D. Create framed map
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    p <- ggplot() +

      annotation_raster(
        raster_img,
        xmin = 0, xmax = 1,
        ymin = 0, ymax = 1
      ) +

      # North arrow
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = 0.93, xend = 0.93,
        y = 0.77, yend = 0.89,
        linewidth = 0.8,
        colour = "black",
        arrow = grid::arrow(
          length = grid::unit(0.16, "cm"),
          type = "closed"
        )
      ) +

      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.93, y = 0.93,
        label = "N",
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 4
      ) +

      # RGB key
      annotate(
        "label",
        x = 0.03, y = 0.97,
        label = "RGB KEY\nR: Red\nG: Green\nB: Blue",
        hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
        size = 3,
        label.size = 0.3,
        fill = "white",
        alpha = 0.92
      ) +

      coord_fixed(
        xlim = c(0, 1),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        expand = FALSE
      ) +

      labs(
        title = paste(
          "THARAKA SUB-COUNTY —", year
        ),
        subtitle = paste(
          scenario_labels[[window]],
          "| Landsat Collection 2 Level-2"
        ),
        caption = paste(
          "True-colour RGB composite | Nominal pixel size: 30 m",
          "\nWhite line: study-area boundary | adaptive 2nd–98th percentile RGB stretch"
        )
      ) +

      theme_void(base_size = 12) +

      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 16,
          hjust = 0.5,
          margin = margin(b = 8)
        ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
          size = 10,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.caption = element_text(
          size = 8,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        panel.border = element_rect(
          colour = "black",
          fill = NA,
          linewidth = 1
        ),
        plot.background = element_rect(
          fill = "white",
          colour = NA
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
      )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # E. Save high-resolution PNG
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    output_file <- file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("Tharaka_", scenario, ".png")
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = output_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 9,
      height = 7,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )

    plot_results$status[i] <- "Success"
    plot_results$file[i] <- output_file

    message("Saved: ", output_file)

  }, error = function(e) {

    plot_results$status[i] <<- paste(
      "Failed:", conditionMessage(e)
    )

    message(
      "Error for ", scenario, ": ",
      conditionMessage(e)
    )

  }, finally = {

    if (file.exists(temp_png)) {
      unlink(temp_png)
    }

  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save processing log and report
# ---------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  plot_results,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Scenario_Plot_Processing_Log.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("ENHANCED MAP EXPORT COMPLETE\n")
cat("Successful:", sum(plot_results$status == "Success"), "\n")
cat("Failed:", sum(plot_results$status != "Success"), "\n")
cat("Output folder:", normalizePath(plot_dir), "\n")
cat("====================================\n")

print(plot_results)

```


```{r section-33-study-area-location-map, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 33: STUDY-AREA LOCATION MAP
# Kenya -> Tharaka-Nithi County -> Tharaka study area
# =========================================================

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(geodata)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create output directories
# ---------------------------------------------------------

locator_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"

boundary_dir <- file.path(
  locator_dir,
  "Administrative_Boundaries"
)

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(
  boundary_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load Kenya administrative boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

message("Loading Kenya administrative boundaries...")

kenya_counties <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 1,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 0,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(kenya_counties) > 0,
  "NAME_1" %in% names(kenya_counties)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Select Tharaka-Nithi County
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county <- kenya_counties[
  grepl(
    "tharaka",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ) &
    grepl(
      "nithi",
      kenya_counties$NAME_1,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
]

if (nrow(county) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one Tharaka-Nithi County feature; found ",
    nrow(county),
    ". Check unique(kenya_counties$NAME_1)."
  )
}

message("Selected county: ", county$NAME_1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Recover the Tharaka study-area boundary
#
# Prefer the existing study_area_sf or study_area object.
# If neither is available, reconstruct it from GADM level 2.
# No Earth Engine query is needed for this location map.
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)) {

  roi_sf <- get("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(roi_sf, "sf")) {
    roi_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(roi_sf)
  }

} else if (exists("study_area", inherits = TRUE)) {

  roi_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    get("study_area", inherits = TRUE)
  )

} else {

  message("Recovering Tharaka boundary from GADM level 2...")

  kenya_adm2 <- sf::st_as_sf(
    geodata::gadm(
      country = "KEN",
      level = 2,
      path = boundary_dir
    )
  )

  roi_sf <- kenya_adm2[
    kenya_adm2$NAME_2 == "Tharaka" &
      kenya_adm2$NAME_1 == "Tharaka-Nithi",
  ]

  if (nrow(roi_sf) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify exactly one Tharaka study-area polygon."
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Standardize and validate geometries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kenya_counties <- sf::st_transform(
  kenya_counties, 4326
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_transform(
  kenya_country, 4326
)

county <- sf::st_transform(
  county, 4326
)

roi_sf <- sf::st_transform(
  roi_sf, 4326
)

roi_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(roi_sf)

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0 ||
    any(sf::st_is_empty(roi_sf))) {
  stop("The Tharaka study-area geometry is empty.")
}

# Retain only polygon components if validity repair
# has produced a geometry collection.
geometry_types <- as.character(
  sf::st_geometry_type(roi_sf)
)

if (any(geometry_types == "GEOMETRY")) {
  roi_sf <- sf::st_collection_extract(
    roi_sf,
    "POLYGON",
    warn = FALSE
  )
}

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0 ||
    !all(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))) {
  stop("The study-area boundary is not a valid polygon.")
}

message("Study-area geometry validated successfully.")

# Confirm the study area intersects the intended county.
overlap <- sf::st_intersects(
  roi_sf,
  county,
  sparse = FALSE
)

if (!all(overlap)) {
  stop(
    "The study-area boundary does not intersect ",
    "Tharaka-Nithi County. Check the selected boundaries."
  )
}

# Calculate percentage of the study area inside the county.
roi_area <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 6933)
county_area <- sf::st_transform(county, 6933)

inside_area <- sf::st_intersection(
  roi_area,
  county_area
)

overlap_pct <- 100 * as.numeric(
  sum(sf::st_area(inside_area)) /
    sum(sf::st_area(roi_area))
)

cat(
  "Percentage of study area inside Tharaka-Nithi County:",
  round(overlap_pct, 2), "%\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Map 1: Kenya, with county boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_kenya <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_country,
    fill = "#F7F7F7",
    colour = "#444444",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_counties,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "#B7B7B7",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E76F51",
    colour = "#8C2D04",
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "KENYA",
    subtitle = "Tharaka-Nithi County highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Map 2: Tharaka-Nithi County and study area
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(county)

county_x <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.12,
  unname(county_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.12
)

county_y <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.08,
  unname(county_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.08
)

p_county <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E9E9E9",
    colour = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#65A765",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA-NITHI COUNTY",
    subtitle = "Tharaka study area highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = county_x,
    ylim = county_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Map 3: Detailed Tharaka study-area boundary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

roi_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(roi_sf)

roi_x <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.025
)

roi_y <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.025
)

p_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#A8D5BA",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA STUDY AREA",
    subtitle = "Boundary used in the Landsat analysis"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = roi_x,
    ylim = roi_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5, size = 9
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Combine the three maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_locator_0 <- (p_kenya | p_county | p_detail) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Location of the Tharaka Study Area, Kenya",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Geographic context for the 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025",
      "seasonal Landsat analysis"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Administrative boundaries: GADM.",
      "Study boundary: Tharaka Sub-county."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 8, hjust = 0
      )
    )
  )

print(p_locator_0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Export the location map
# ---------------------------------------------------------

png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,

)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 33: STUDY-AREA LOCATION MAP
# Kenya -> Tharaka-Nithi County -> Tharaka study area
# =========================================================

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(geodata)
library(reticulate)
library(jsonlite)
library(geojsonsf)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Output folder
# ---------------------------------------------------------

locator_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"
dir.create(locator_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

boundary_dir <- file.path(locator_dir, "Administrative_Boundaries")
dir.create(boundary_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Download GADM administrative boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kenya_counties <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 1,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

kenya_country <- sf::st_as_sf(
  geodata::gadm(
    country = "KEN",
    level = 0,
    path = boundary_dir
  )
)

# Inspect county names if necessary
print(sort(unique(kenya_counties$NAME_1)))

# Select Tharaka-Nithi County robustly
county <- kenya_counties[
  grepl(
    "tharaka",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ) &
  grepl(
    "nithi",
    kenya_counties$NAME_1,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ),
]

if (nrow(county) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected one Tharaka-Nithi County feature, found ",
    nrow(county),
    ". Check kenya_counties$NAME_1."
  )
}

cat("Selected county:", county$NAME_1, "\n")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Convert Earth Engine ROI to sf and repair its geometry
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)

# Extract the ROI already used in the Landsat analysis
roi_info <- reticulate::py_to_r(
  ee$Feature(roi)$getInfo()
)

roi_feature <- list(
  type = "Feature",
  properties = list(name = "Tharaka study area"),
  geometry = roi_info$geometry
)

roi_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  roi_feature,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  null = "null"
)

roi_sf <- geojsonsf::geojson_sf(roi_json)

# Set coordinate reference systems consistently
county <- sf::st_transform(county, 4326)
kenya_counties <- sf::st_transform(kenya_counties, 4326)
kenya_country <- sf::st_transform(kenya_country, 4326)
roi_sf <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 4326)

# Repair the geometry AFTER recreating roi_sf
cat("Original geometry validity:\n")
print(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf, reason = TRUE))

roi_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(roi_sf)

# Keep polygonal geometry; if already polygonal, no extraction is needed
if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf))) {
  roi_sf <- sf::st_collection_extract(
    roi_sf, "POLYGON", warn = FALSE
  )
}

# Confirm the final geometry
valid_roi <- sf::st_is_valid(roi_sf)

if (!all(valid_roi)) {
  stop("ROI geometry remains invalid after repair.")
}

if (nrow(roi_sf) == 0) {
  stop("No valid polygon remains in roi_sf.")
}

cat("Study-area geometry validated successfully.\n")

# Verify the study area still overlaps the intended county
overlap <- sf::st_intersects(
  roi_sf, county, sparse = FALSE
)

if (!all(overlap)) {
  warning("The ROI does not intersect Tharaka-Nithi County.")
}

# Calculate percentage of ROI inside the county
roi_area <- sf::st_transform(roi_sf, 6933)
county_area <- sf::st_transform(county, 6933)

inside_area <- sf::st_intersection(
  roi_area, county_area
)

overlap_pct <- 100 *
  sum(sf::st_area(inside_area)) /
  sum(sf::st_area(roi_area))

cat(
  "Percentage of study area inside Tharaka-Nithi County:",
  round(as.numeric(overlap_pct), 2), "%\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create map 1: Kenya with county highlighted
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_kenya <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_country,
    fill = "#F7F7F7",
    colour = "#444444",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = kenya_counties,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "#B7B7B7",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E76F51",
    colour = "#8C2D04",
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "KENYA",
    subtitle = "Tharaka-Nithi County highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create map 2: County with study area highlighted
# ---------------------------------------------------------

county_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(county)

county_x <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.12,
  unname(county_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.12
)

county_y <- c(
  unname(county_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.08,
  unname(county_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.08
)

p_county <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county,
    fill = "#E9E9E9",
    colour = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#65A765",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA-NITHI COUNTY",
    subtitle = "Tharaka study area highlighted"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = county_x,
    ylim = county_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create map 3: Detailed study-area boundary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

roi_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(roi_sf)

roi_x <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.025
)

roi_y <- c(
  unname(roi_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.025,
  unname(roi_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.025
)

p_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = roi_sf,
    fill = "#A8D5BA",
    colour = "#185C37",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "THARAKA STUDY AREA",
    subtitle = "Boundary used in the Landsat analysis"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = roi_x,
    ylim = roi_y,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Combine the three maps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_locator_0 <- (p_kenya | p_county | p_detail) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Location of the Tharaka Study Area, Kenya",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Geographic context for the 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025",

    ),
    caption = paste(

    ),

        size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
    )
  )

print(p_locator_0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Export publication-quality files
# ---------------------------------------------------------


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE LOCATOR MAP IN THE EXISTING MAP DIRECTORY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_dir <- "Tharaka_Landsat_Enhanced_Maps"

dir.create(

)
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 34: PRELIMINARY ANNUAL LAND-COVER AREA ESTIMATES
# Source: MODIS MCD12Q1.061 / IGBP LC_Type1, 500 m
# Does not require the historical reference-label worksheet.
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)

if (!exists("roi", inherits = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Earth Engine study-area geometry 'roi' is missing. ",
    "Run the preceding study-area and Earth Engine chunks first."
  )
}

if (!exists("ee", inherits = TRUE)) {
  ee <- reticulate::import("ee", convert = FALSE)
  ee$Initialize(project = "thinking-leaf-305215")
}

# Reuse the existing Earth Engine helpers; define them if absent.
if (!exists("ee_method", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)) {
  ee_method <- function(object, method, ...) {
    fn <- reticulate::py_get_attr(object, method)
    reticulate::py_call(fn, ...)
  }
}

if (!exists("ee_get_info", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)) {
  ee_get_info <- function(object) {
    reticulate::py_to_r(ee_method(object, "getInfo"))
  }
}

# MCD12Q1 version 6.1 currently supplies annual maps from 2001–2024.
# Use nearest available source years for requested periods 2000 and 2025.
landcover_year_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~requested_year, ~dataset_year, ~year_note,
  2000L,           2001L,         "2001 source year; proxy for 2000",
  2010L,           2010L,         "Exact source year",
  2020L,           2020L,         "Exact source year",
  2025L,           2024L,         "2024 source year; proxy for 2025"
)

class_levels <- c(
  "Forest",
  "Bushland / shrub-savanna",
  "Grassland",
  "Agriculture",
  "Settlement",
  "Other / non-target"
)

modis_lc_collection <- ee$ImageCollection("MODIS/061/MCD12Q1")

# The grouped reduction sums pixel area (hectares) by the LC_Type1 code.
# Image band order is important: area first, class code second.
area_ha_band <- ee$Image$pixelArea()$
  divide(10000)$
  rename("area_ha")

group_reducer <- ee_method(
  ee$Reducer$sum(),
  "group",
  groupField = 1L,
  groupName = "land_cover_code"
)

area_results <- vector("list", nrow(landcover_year_map))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(landcover_year_map))) {

  requested_year <- landcover_year_map$requested_year[i]
  dataset_year <- landcover_year_map$dataset_year[i]

  start_date <- sprintf("%04d-01-01", dataset_year)
  end_date <- sprintf("%04d-01-01", dataset_year + 1L)

  message(
    "Calculating area for source year ", dataset_year,
    " (requested period ", requested_year, ")..."
  )

  annual_collection <- ee_method(
    modis_lc_collection,
    "filterDate",
    start_date,
    end_date
  )

  n_images <- as.integer(
    ee_get_info(ee_method(annual_collection, "size"))
  )

  if (is.na(n_images) || n_images < 1L) {
    stop(
      "No MCD12Q1 image found for dataset year ", dataset_year,
      ". Check dataset availability in Earth Engine."
    )
  }

  annual_image <- ee_method(annual_collection, "first")
  class_band <- ee_method(
    ee_method(annual_image, "select", "LC_Type1"),
    "rename",
    "land_cover_code"
  )

  grouped_image <- ee_method(area_ha_band, "addBands", class_band)

  reduction_object <- ee_method(
    grouped_image,
    "reduceRegion",
    reducer = group_reducer,
    geometry = roi,
    scale = 500,
    maxPixels = 1e10,
    tileScale = 4
  )

  reduction_info <- ee_get_info(reduction_object)
  groups <- reduction_info[["groups"]]

  if (is.null(groups) || length(groups) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "The grouped area reduction returned no classes for ",
      dataset_year, ". Check the ROI and Earth Engine response."
    )
  }

  group_table <- purrr::map_dfr(groups, function(g) {
    g <- as.list(g)
    tibble(
      modis_code = as.integer(unlist(g[["land_cover_code"]])),
      area_ha = as.numeric(unlist(g[["sum"]]))
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      land_cover_class = case_when(
        modis_code %in% 1:5 ~ "Forest",
        modis_code %in% 6:9 ~ "Bushland / shrub-savanna",
        modis_code == 10 ~ "Grassland",
        modis_code %in% c(12, 14) ~ "Agriculture",
        modis_code == 13 ~ "Settlement",
        TRUE ~ "Other / non-target"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(land_cover_class) %>%
    summarise(area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  area_results[[i]] <- group_table %>%
    mutate(
      requested_year = requested_year,
      dataset_year = dataset_year,
      .before = 1
    )
}

observed_area_long <- bind_rows(area_results)

# Include classes absent in a year as zero so tables/graphs stay comparable.
landcover_area_trends <- tidyr::crossing(
  landcover_year_map,
  land_cover_class = class_levels
) %>%
  left_join(
    observed_area_long,
    by = c("requested_year", "dataset_year", "land_cover_class")
  ) %>%
  mutate(area_ha = tidyr::replace_na(area_ha, 0)) %>%
  group_by(requested_year, dataset_year, year_note) %>%
  mutate(
    total_mapped_area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_pct = if_else(
      total_mapped_area_ha > 0,
      100 * area_ha / total_mapped_area_ha,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(dataset_year, match(land_cover_class, class_levels))

# Preserve the detailed long-format results, including bushland and other.
results_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(
  landcover_area_trends,
  file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_MODIS_Landcover_Area_Trends_Long.csv")
)

cat("\nAnnual area calculations completed.\n")
print(landcover_area_trends, n = Inf, width = Inf)

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# DIAGNOSTIC: VERIFY MODIS URBAN / BUILT-UP PIXELS
# =========================================================

settlement_pixel_check <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(landcover_year_map)),
  function(i) {

    requested_year <- landcover_year_map$requested_year[i]
    dataset_year <- landcover_year_map$dataset_year[i]

    annual_collection <- ee_method(
      modis_lc_collection,
      "filterDate",
      sprintf("%04d-01-01", dataset_year),
      sprintf("%04d-01-01", dataset_year + 1L)
    )

    image <- ee_method(annual_collection, "first")
    lc <- ee_method(image, "select", "LC_Type1")

    # IGBP class 13 = urban and built-up
    urban_mask <- ee_method(lc, "eq", 13L)
    urban_mask <- ee_method(urban_mask, "selfMask")
    urban_mask <- ee_method(urban_mask, "rename", "urban_pixel")

    count_result <- ee_method(
      urban_mask,
      "reduceRegion",
      reducer = ee$Reducer$count(),
      geometry = roi,
      scale = 500,
      maxPixels = 1e10,
      tileScale = 4
    )

    count_info <- ee_get_info(count_result)
    pixel_count <- count_info[["urban_pixel"]]

    tibble::tibble(
      requested_year = requested_year,
      dataset_year = dataset_year,
      urban_class_pixels = if (is.null(pixel_count)) {
        0
      } else {
        as.numeric(pixel_count)
      }
    )
  }
)

print(settlement_pixel_check, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  settlement_pixel_check,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "Tharaka_MODIS_Urban_Pixel_Diagnostic.csv"
  )
)
```
