# 34. Optional labelled Landsat classification (disabled by default)

This labelled Random Forest approach is retained for reference only and is disabled by default in this image-led version. Since historical labels are hard to assign confidently for every year, Section 38 instead discovers spectral/seasonal clusters from the seasonal Landsat imagery, then asks for a transparent review of the cluster-to-cover interpretation before producing named land-cover trends.

```{r section-34-landed-rf-classification, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 34: OPTIONAL LABEL-LED LANDSAT RANDOM FOREST CLASSIFICATION
# Inputs: selected_composites, roi, and reviewed CSV labels
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(png)
library(patchwork)
library(reticulate)

classification_label_file <- "Tharaka_Historical_Reference_Review.csv"
results_dir <- "Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results"
classification_map_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Landsat_RF_Classification_Maps")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(classification_map_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(classification_label_file)) {
  stop(
    "Reviewed reference labels were not found: ", classification_label_file,
    ". Place this CSV beside the R Markdown file and rerun Section 38."
  )
}

if (!exists("selected_composites", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists("roi", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists("ee", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists("ee_method", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists("ee_get_info", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)) {
  stop("Required Earth Engine objects are missing. Run the previous workflow through Section 12 first.")
}

classification_labels <- readr::read_csv(
  classification_label_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    point_id = readr::col_character(),
    longitude = readr::col_double(),
    latitude = readr::col_double(),
    year = readr::col_integer(),
    land_cover = readr::col_character(),
    confidence = readr::col_character(),
    evidence = readr::col_character(),
    notes = readr::col_character()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    point_id = as.character(point_id),
    land_cover = tolower(trimws(land_cover)),
    confidence = tolower(trimws(confidence)),
    evidence = tolower(trimws(evidence))
  )

required_label_columns <- c(
  "point_id", "longitude", "latitude", "year",
  "land_cover", "confidence", "evidence"
)
missing_label_columns <- setdiff(required_label_columns, names(classification_labels))
if (length(missing_label_columns) > 0L) {
  stop("Reference CSV is missing columns: ", paste(missing_label_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

study_years_rf <- c(2000L, 2010L, 2020L, 2025L)
class_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  class_code = 1:5,
  land_cover = c("forest", "bushland", "grassland", "farmland", "settlement"),
  class_label = c("Forest", "Bushland / shrub-savanna", "Grassland", "Cultivated agriculture", "Settlement"),
  class_colour = c("#1B7837", "#A6611A", "#7FBF7B", "#F1A340", "#C51B7D")
)

invalid_years_rf <- setdiff(unique(classification_labels$year), study_years_rf)
invalid_classes_rf <- setdiff(unique(classification_labels$land_cover), class_lookup$land_cover)
if (length(invalid_years_rf) > 0L) stop("Unexpected label years: ", paste(invalid_years_rf, collapse = ", "))
if (length(invalid_classes_rf) > 0L) stop("Unrecognised labels: ", paste(invalid_classes_rf, collapse = ", "))
if (anyDuplicated(classification_labels[c("point_id", "year")])) {
  stop("Duplicate point_id/year rows found in the reference-label CSV.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(classification_labels$longitude)) ||
    any(!is.finite(classification_labels$latitude))) {
  stop("The reference-label CSV contains missing or invalid coordinates.")
}

# Preserve high- and medium-confidence reviewed labels; exclude low-confidence,
# uncertain or unrecognised records from model fitting.
model_labels <- classification_labels %>%
  filter(
    year %in% study_years_rf,
    confidence %in% c("high", "medium"),
    land_cover %in% class_lookup$land_cover,
    is.finite(longitude),
    is.finite(latitude)
  ) %>%
  left_join(class_lookup %>% select(land_cover, class_code), by = "land_cover")

label_counts <- model_labels %>%
  count(year, land_cover, name = "labelled_records") %>%
  arrange(year, match(land_cover, class_lookup$land_cover))
readr::write_csv(label_counts, file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Reference_Label_Counts.csv"))
print(label_counts, n = Inf)

# Temporal consistency check: same point labels across years may be correct,
# but should be confirmed as independently reviewed historical observations.
point_temporal_consistency <- model_labels %>%
  group_by(point_id) %>%
  summarise(
    years_labelled = n_distinct(year),
    classes_across_years = n_distinct(land_cover),
    labels_by_year = paste(year, land_cover, sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(
  point_temporal_consistency,
  file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Reference_Temporal_Consistency.csv")
)

n_stable_points <- sum(point_temporal_consistency$classes_across_years == 1L)
n_points <- nrow(point_temporal_consistency)
cat("Unique labelled locations:", n_points, "\n")
cat("Locations with one unchanged class across reviewed years:", n_stable_points, "of", n_points, "\n")
if (n_points > 0L && n_stable_points == n_points) {
  warning(
    "Every point has the same land-cover label in all reviewed years. Please confirm this reflects independent review of each historical year rather than carrying labels forward. The model will use the labels exactly as supplied."
  )
}

# Use a spatial holdout: all year records for selected point IDs are kept out
# of training so the same location cannot appear in both training and validation.
set.seed(2026)
point_class_for_split <- model_labels %>%
  count(point_id, land_cover, name = "n_years_with_class") %>%
  group_by(point_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_years_with_class), land_cover, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

validation_ids <- unlist(
  lapply(
    split(point_class_for_split$point_id, point_class_for_split$land_cover),
    function(ids) sample(ids, size = max(1L, floor(length(ids) * 0.20)))
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

model_labels <- model_labels %>%
  mutate(
    split = if_else(point_id %in% validation_ids, "validation", "training")
  )

split_counts <- model_labels %>%
  distinct(point_id, land_cover, split) %>%
  count(split, land_cover, name = "unique_locations")
readr::write_csv(split_counts, file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_RF_Spatial_Holdout_Counts.csv"))
print(split_counts, n = Inf)

# Build 36 consistent predictors per year: six reflectance bands plus NDVI,
# NDWI and NDBI for each of the four seasonal composites.
spectral_bands_rf <- c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
season_order_rf <- c("dry_feb", "dry_sep", "wet_may", "wet_dec")
feature_band_names_rf <- unlist(lapply(
  season_order_rf,
  function(w) c(
    paste0(spectral_bands_rf, "_", w),
    paste0("NDVI_", w), paste0("NDWI_", w), paste0("NDBI_", w)
  )
), use.names = FALSE)

build_feature_stack_rf <- function(year_value) {
  stacked <- NULL
  for (win in season_order_rf) {
    composite_key <- paste(year_value, win, sep = "_")
    img <- selected_composites[[composite_key]]
    if (is.null(img)) {
      stop("Missing seasonal Landsat composite: ", composite_key)
    }

    reflectance <- ee_method(img, "select", spectral_bands_rf)
    reflectance <- ee_method(
      reflectance, "rename", paste0(spectral_bands_rf, "_", win)
    )

    # Use explicit arithmetic rather than normalizedDifference():
    # Earth Engine normalizedDifference masks a pixel when either input
    # reflectance is negative, which can occur after Landsat SR scaling.
    safe_ratio_index_rf <- function(image, band_a, band_b, output_name) {
      band_a_image <- ee_method(image, "select", band_a)
      band_b_image <- ee_method(image, "select", band_b)
      numerator <- ee_method(band_a_image, "subtract", band_b_image)
      denominator <- ee_method(band_a_image, "add", band_b_image)
      near_zero <- ee_method(ee_method(denominator, "abs"), "lt", 1e-6)
      denominator <- ee_method(denominator, "where", near_zero, 1e-6)
      index_image <- ee_method(numerator, "divide", denominator)
      ee_method(index_image, "rename", output_name)
    }

    ndvi <- safe_ratio_index_rf(img, "nir", "red", paste0("NDVI_", win))
    ndwi <- safe_ratio_index_rf(img, "green", "nir", paste0("NDWI_", win))
    ndbi <- safe_ratio_index_rf(img, "swir1", "nir", paste0("NDBI_", win))

    season_stack <- ee_method(reflectance, "addBands", ndvi)
    season_stack <- ee_method(season_stack, "addBands", ndwi)
    season_stack <- ee_method(season_stack, "addBands", ndbi)

    if (is.null(stacked)) {
      stacked <- season_stack
    } else {
      stacked <- ee_method(stacked, "addBands", season_stack)
    }
  }
  ee_method(stacked, "clip", roi)
}

annual_feature_stacks_rf <- setNames(vector("list", length(study_years_rf)), as.character(study_years_rf))
for (yr in study_years_rf) {
  message("Building seasonal spectral feature stack for ", yr, "...")
  annual_feature_stacks_rf[[as.character(yr)]] <- build_feature_stack_rf(yr)
}

# Convert only the reviewed point attributes and point geometries to Earth Engine.
training_sf_rf <- model_labels %>%
  select(point_id, longitude, latitude, year, land_cover, class_code, split, confidence, evidence) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
training_fc_rf <- rgee::sf_as_ee(training_sf_rf, via = "getInfo")

samples_by_year_rf <- vector("list", length(study_years_rf))
names(samples_by_year_rf) <- as.character(study_years_rf)
for (yr in study_years_rf) {
  year_points <- ee_method(
    training_fc_rf, "filter", ee$Filter$eq("year", as.integer(yr))
  )
  samples_by_year_rf[[as.character(yr)]] <- ee_method(
    annual_feature_stacks_rf[[as.character(yr)]], "sampleRegions",
    collection = year_points,
    properties = c("point_id", "land_cover", "class_code", "split", "year"),
    scale = 30,
    tileScale = 4,
    geometries = TRUE
  )
}

sampled_all_years_rf <- samples_by_year_rf[[1]]
if (length(samples_by_year_rf) > 1L) {
  for (j in 2:length(samples_by_year_rf)) {
    sampled_all_years_rf <- ee_method(
      sampled_all_years_rf, "merge", samples_by_year_rf[[j]]
    )
  }
}

train_samples_rf <- ee_method(
  sampled_all_years_rf, "filter", ee$Filter$eq("split", "training")
)
validation_samples_rf <- ee_method(
  sampled_all_years_rf, "filter", ee$Filter$eq("split", "validation")
)

n_train_samples_rf <- as.integer(ee_get_info(ee_method(train_samples_rf, "size")))
n_validation_samples_rf <- as.integer(ee_get_info(ee_method(validation_samples_rf, "size")))
cat("Unmasked training point-year samples:", n_train_samples_rf, "\n")
cat("Unmasked validation point-year samples:", n_validation_samples_rf, "\n")
cat("Unique spatial validation locations:", length(unique(validation_ids)), "\n")
if (is.na(n_train_samples_rf) || n_train_samples_rf < 20L) {
  stop("Too few valid training samples remain after masking. Review seasonal coverage or collect more reference points.")
}
if (is.na(n_validation_samples_rf) || n_validation_samples_rf < 5L) {
  stop("Too few valid validation samples remain after masking. Review seasonal coverage or collect more reference points.")
}

train_hist_rf <- ee_get_info(
  ee_method(train_samples_rf, "aggregate_histogram", "class_code")
)
train_hist_codes_rf <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(names(unlist(train_hist_rf))))
missing_train_codes_rf <- setdiff(class_lookup$class_code, train_hist_codes_rf)
if (length(missing_train_codes_rf) > 0L) {
  missing_classes_rf <- class_lookup$land_cover[match(missing_train_codes_rf, class_lookup$class_code)]
  stop(
    "The usable training samples are missing these classes after masking: ",
    paste(missing_classes_rf, collapse = ", "),
    ". Add/review reference points or reconsider seasonal predictors before fitting the model."
  )
}

# Fit one pooled Random Forest so the same predictor definitions and model
# are used across years. Random Forest predicts classes; it does not improve
# imagery radiometry or substitute for independent reference review.
rf_classifier_rf <- ee$Classifier$smileRandomForest(
  numberOfTrees = 300L,
  seed = 2026L
)
trained_rf_model <- ee_method(
  rf_classifier_rf, "train",
  train_samples_rf,
  "class_code",
  feature_band_names_rf
)

# Spatial-holdout validation. The sample records repeat each holdout location
# across years, so report both record count and unique held-out location count.
classified_validation_rf <- ee_method(
  validation_samples_rf, "classify", trained_rf_model
)
confusion_matrix_rf <- ee_method(
  classified_validation_rf, "errorMatrix", "class_code", "classification",
  as.list(class_lookup$class_code)
)
overall_accuracy_rf <- as.numeric(ee_get_info(ee_method(confusion_matrix_rf, "accuracy")))
kappa_rf <- as.numeric(ee_get_info(ee_method(confusion_matrix_rf, "kappa")))
validation_metrics_rf <- tibble::tibble(
  model = "Pooled Random Forest; 300 trees; 36 seasonal features",
  usable_training_sample_records = n_train_samples_rf,
  usable_validation_sample_records = n_validation_samples_rf,
  unique_training_locations = length(unique(setdiff(model_labels$point_id, validation_ids))),
  unique_validation_locations = length(unique(validation_ids)),
  overall_accuracy = overall_accuracy_rf,
  kappa = kappa_rf,
  validation_note = "Spatial holdout by point_id; class-specific validation counts are small and repeated year rows are not fully independent."
)
readr::write_csv(
  validation_metrics_rf,
  file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Accuracy_Metrics.csv")
)
print(validation_metrics_rf)

# Save the confusion matrix and class-level validation metrics. Failure to
# serialize the matrix will not invalidate the scalar accuracy metrics above.
confusion_export_ok <- tryCatch({
  cm_info_rf <- ee_get_info(confusion_matrix_rf)
  cm_array_rf <- if (is.list(cm_info_rf) && !is.null(cm_info_rf$array)) cm_info_rf$array else cm_info_rf
  cm_values_rf <- if (is.matrix(cm_array_rf)) {
    as.matrix(cm_array_rf)
  } else {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(cm_array_rf, function(z) as.numeric(unlist(z))))
  }
  if (is.null(dim(cm_values_rf)) || nrow(cm_values_rf) != nrow(class_lookup) || ncol(cm_values_rf) != nrow(class_lookup)) {
    stop("Confusion matrix did not return the expected five-class structure.")
  }

  predicted_names_rf <- paste0("Predicted_", make.names(class_lookup$class_label))
  cm_df_rf <- as.data.frame(cm_values_rf)
  names(cm_df_rf) <- predicted_names_rf
  cm_df_rf <- tibble::as_tibble(cm_df_rf) %>%
    mutate(actual_class = class_lookup$class_label, .before = 1)
  readr::write_csv(cm_df_rf, file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Confusion_Matrix.csv"))

  actual_n_rf <- rowSums(cm_values_rf)
  predicted_n_rf <- colSums(cm_values_rf)
  correct_rf <- diag(cm_values_rf)
  producer_accuracy_rf <- ifelse(actual_n_rf > 0, correct_rf / actual_n_rf, NA_real_)
  user_accuracy_rf <- ifelse(predicted_n_rf > 0, correct_rf / predicted_n_rf, NA_real_)
  f1_rf <- ifelse(
    is.finite(producer_accuracy_rf + user_accuracy_rf) &
      (producer_accuracy_rf + user_accuracy_rf) > 0,
    2 * producer_accuracy_rf * user_accuracy_rf /
      (producer_accuracy_rf + user_accuracy_rf),
    NA_real_
  )

  class_validation_metrics_rf <- tibble::tibble(
    class_code = class_lookup$class_code,
    land_cover_class = class_lookup$class_label,
    validation_reference_count = as.numeric(actual_n_rf),
    validation_predicted_count = as.numeric(predicted_n_rf),
    producer_accuracy = as.numeric(producer_accuracy_rf),
    user_accuracy = as.numeric(user_accuracy_rf),
    f1_score = as.numeric(f1_rf)
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    class_validation_metrics_rf,
    file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Class_Accuracy.csv")
  )
  print(class_validation_metrics_rf, n = Inf)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Confusion-matrix/class-accuracy export was skipped: ", conditionMessage(e))
  FALSE
})

# Apply the single trained classifier to each year's 36-band feature stack,
# estimate mapped hectares by class and download high-resolution map previews.
class_palette_rf <- class_lookup$class_colour
classified_landcover_images <- setNames(vector("list", length(study_years_rf)), as.character(study_years_rf))
area_summaries_rf <- vector("list", length(study_years_rf))
names(area_summaries_rf) <- as.character(study_years_rf)

area_group_reducer_rf <- ee_method(
  ee$Reducer$sum(), "group",
  groupField = 1L,
  groupName = "class_code"
)

for (yr in study_years_rf) {
  year_key <- as.character(yr)
  message("Classifying Landsat feature stack for ", yr, "...")

  classified_img <- ee_method(
    annual_feature_stacks_rf[[year_key]], "classify", trained_rf_model
  )
  classified_img <- ee_method(classified_img, "rename", "class_code")
  classified_img <- ee_method(classified_img, "clip", roi)
  classified_landcover_images[[year_key]] <- classified_img

  area_ha_band_rf <- ee$Image$pixelArea()$divide(10000)$rename("area_ha")
  area_image_rf <- ee_method(area_ha_band_rf, "addBands", classified_img)
  area_dict_rf <- ee_method(
    area_image_rf, "reduceRegion",
    reducer = area_group_reducer_rf,
    geometry = roi,
    scale = 30,
    maxPixels = 1e13,
    tileScale = 4
  )
  area_info_rf <- ee_get_info(area_dict_rf)
  groups_rf <- area_info_rf[["groups"]]
  observed_rf <- if (is.null(groups_rf) || length(groups_rf) == 0L) {
    tibble::tibble(class_code = integer(), area_ha = double())
  } else {
    purrr::map_dfr(groups_rf, function(g) {
      g <- as.list(g)
      tibble::tibble(
        class_code = as.integer(unlist(g[["class_code"]])),
        area_ha = as.numeric(unlist(g[["sum"]]))
      )
    })
  }

  area_summaries_rf[[year_key]] <- class_lookup %>%
    left_join(observed_rf, by = "class_code") %>%
    mutate(
      area_ha = tidyr::replace_na(area_ha, 0),
      requested_year = as.integer(yr),
      source_note = "30 m Landsat feature stack; expanded seasonal windows",
      .before = 1
    )

  # Produce a map image at a high preview dimension. The GeoTIFF export
  # option appears separately in Section 39 for use in QGIS.
  visualized_class_rf <- ee$Image$visualize(
    classified_img,
    min = 1,
    max = 5,
    palette = class_palette_rf
  )
  thumb_url_rf <- reticulate::py_to_r(
    visualized_class_rf$getThumbURL(
      reticulate::dict(
        region = roi,
        dimensions = 1800,
        format = "png"
      )
    )
  )
  temp_map_rf <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  download.file(
    url = thumb_url_rf,
    destfile = temp_map_rf,
    mode = "wb",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  map_raster_rf <- png::readPNG(temp_map_rf)
  unlink(temp_map_rf)

  p_map_rf <- ggplot() +
    annotation_raster(
      map_raster_rf,
      xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Tharaka Sub-county — Landsat Random Forest", yr),
      subtitle = "30 m nominal pixel size | pooled model using four seasonal reflectance/index stacks",
      caption = paste(
        "Preliminary supervised classification. Validate with independent reference data.",
        "Settlement and small/fragmented classes remain sensitive to sample coverage."
      )
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.1),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
    )

  legend_df_rf <- class_lookup %>%
    mutate(land_cover_label = factor(class_label, levels = class_label))
  p_legend_rf <- ggplot(
    legend_df_rf,
    aes(x = class_code, y = 1, colour = land_cover_label)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(class_lookup$class_colour, class_lookup$class_label)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )

  p_map_with_legend_rf <- p_map_rf / p_legend_rf +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(10, 1))

  ggsave(
    file.path(classification_map_dir, paste0("Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Classification_", yr, ".png")),
    p_map_with_legend_rf,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(classification_map_dir, paste0("Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Classification_", yr, ".pdf")),
    p_map_with_legend_rf,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )

  # Include each class map in the knitted PDF as well as saving the files.
  print(p_map_with_legend_rf)
}

landcover_area_trends_rf <- bind_rows(area_summaries_rf) %>%
  group_by(requested_year) %>%
  mutate(
    total_mapped_area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_pct = if_else(total_mapped_area_ha > 0, 100 * area_ha / total_mapped_area_ha, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(requested_year, class_code)

readr::write_csv(
  landcover_area_trends_rf,
  file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Area_Trends_Long.csv")
)

# Area coverage check, calculated in an equal-area projection where possible.
study_area_polygon_rf <- if (exists("roi_sf", inherits = TRUE)) {
  get("roi_sf", inherits = TRUE)
} else if (exists("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)) {
  get("study_area_sf", inherits = TRUE)
} else if (exists("study_area", inherits = TRUE)) {
  sf::st_as_sf(get("study_area", inherits = TRUE))
} else {
  NULL
}
study_area_ha_rf <- if (is.null(study_area_polygon_rf)) {
  NA_real_
} else {
  sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(sf::st_transform(study_area_polygon_rf, 6933)))) / 10000
}

annual_coverage_rf <- landcover_area_trends_rf %>%
  group_by(requested_year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mapped_area_ha = first(total_mapped_area_ha),
    study_area_ha = study_area_ha_rf,
    mapped_area_pct_of_study_area = if (
      is.finite(study_area_ha_rf) && study_area_ha_rf > 0
    ) 100 * first(total_mapped_area_ha) / study_area_ha_rf else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_csv(annual_coverage_rf, file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Mapped_Area_QC.csv"))
print(annual_coverage_rf, n = Inf)

# Clearer area trends: separate y-scales make smaller classes visible.
p_rf_area_trends <- ggplot(
  landcover_area_trends_rf,
  aes(x = requested_year, y = area_ha, colour = class_label, group = class_label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~class_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = study_years_rf) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = stats::setNames(class_lookup$class_colour, class_lookup$class_label)) +
  labs(
    title = "Landsat-based land-cover area trends in Tharaka Sub-county",
    subtitle = "Pooled Random Forest; area in hectares; each class panel has its own y-axis",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Estimated mapped area (ha)",
    caption = paste(
      "30 m nominal pixels. One shared classifier across years, four seasonal windows and spectral indices.",
      "Preliminary estimates; see spatial-holdout accuracy metrics and mapped-area QC."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.1)
  )

print(p_rf_area_trends)
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Area_Trends.png"), p_rf_area_trends, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Area_Trends.pdf"), p_rf_area_trends, width = 12, height = 10, bg = "white")

p_rf_share_trends <- ggplot(
  landcover_area_trends_rf,
  aes(x = requested_year, y = area_pct, colour = class_label, group = class_label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~class_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = study_years_rf) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1, suffix = "%")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = stats::setNames(class_lookup$class_colour, class_lookup$class_label)) +
  labs(
    title = "Land-cover composition trends in Tharaka Sub-county",
    subtitle = "Share of classified pixels; each class panel has its own y-axis",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage of mapped land cover",
    caption = "Preliminary supervised estimates; interpret alongside accuracy, sample balance and mapped-area coverage."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
  )

print(p_rf_share_trends)
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Share_Trends.png"), p_rf_share_trends, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Share_Trends.pdf"), p_rf_share_trends, width = 12, height = 10, bg = "white")

cat("\nSECTION 38 COMPLETED\n")
cat("Classification maps: ", normalizePath(classification_map_dir, winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Area trends: ", normalizePath(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Area_Trends_Long.csv"), winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Accuracy metrics: ", normalizePath(file.path(results_dir, "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Accuracy_Metrics.csv"), winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r section-35-export-classified-rasters, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 35: OPTIONAL EXPORT OF CLASSIFIED MAPS FOR QGIS
# This is OFF by default to avoid submitting Drive tasks at every Knit.
# =========================================================

export_classified_maps_to_drive <- FALSE
classified_drive_folder <- "Tharaka_Landsat_RF_Classification"

if (!exists("classified_landcover_images", inherits = TRUE)) {
  message("Section 35 skipped: labelled Random Forest classification is disabled in this image-led version.")
} else if (isTRUE(export_classified_maps_to_drive)) {
  export_tasks_rf <- list()
  for (yr in c(2000L, 2010L, 2020L, 2025L)) {
    image_to_export <- classified_landcover_images[[as.character(yr)]]
    if (is.null(image_to_export)) {
      warning("Skipping year without a classified image: ", yr)
      next
    }

    task_description <- paste0("Tharaka_Landsat_RF_", yr)
    export_task_rf <- ee$batch$Export$image$toDrive(
      image = image_to_export,
      description = task_description,
      folder = classified_drive_folder,
      fileNamePrefix = task_description,
      region = roi,
      scale = 30,
      crs = "EPSG:6933",
      maxPixels = 1e13,
      fileFormat = "GeoTIFF"
    )
    export_task_rf$start()
    export_tasks_rf[[as.character(yr)]] <- export_task_rf
    task_status_rf <- reticulate::py_to_r(export_task_rf$status())
    cat(yr, "export state:", task_status_rf[["state"]], "\n")
  }
  message("Exports submitted. Monitor the Tasks tab in the Earth Engine Code Editor or task status in R.")
} else {
  message("GeoTIFF exports are disabled. Set export_classified_maps_to_drive <- TRUE and run this chunk interactively when ready to export the four supervised maps to Google Drive for QGIS.")
}
```

### Optional alternative: labelled Random Forest

The label-led Random Forest code in Section 34 is retained in this document for reference, but it is not run by default in this image-led version. Set its chunk option `eval=TRUE` only if you later decide to use independently reviewed year-specific labels.

### Interpretation note for the supervised Landsat results

The supervised maps use the supplied labels exactly as provided. The current label file contains 50 unique locations repeated across the four years, and each of those locations has the same class label in all four years. If this reflects independent visual review and truly stable locations, the labels can be used as entered; if labels were carried forward for convenience, review them independently by year before interpreting change. Only four forest points and five farmland points are present in the supplied point sample, so per-class accuracy for those classes will be uncertain. Add more well-distributed independent reference locations before using these results for high-stakes land management decisions.

# 36. Export seasonal Landsat composites for image-led learning

If the 16 seasonal composites are not already saved as local multiband GeoTIFFs, run this optional chunk interactively after the earlier Earth Engine sections have created `selected_composites`. It submits one Google Drive export task for each year/window. Download the resulting `Tharaka_Seasonal_*.tif` files into `01_data/landsat/qgis_input`, then rerun Section 40 to clip them with QGIS and Section 38 to learn clusters and calculate trends. The export switch is deliberately off by default.

```{r section-36-export-seasonal-composites, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 36: OPTIONAL EXPORT OF THE 16 SEASONAL COMPOSITES
# Run interactively after the Earth Engine composites exist.
# =========================================================

export_seasonal_composites_to_drive <- FALSE
seasonal_drive_folder <- "Tharaka_Seasonal_Landsat_Composites"

if (isTRUE(export_seasonal_composites_to_drive)) {
  if (!exists("selected_composites", inherits = TRUE) ||
      !exists("roi", inherits = TRUE) ||
      !exists("ee", inherits = TRUE)) {
    stop("Run the Earth Engine setup and seasonal-composite sections before Section 36.")
  }

  expected_seasonal_keys <- as.vector(outer(
    c(2000L, 2010L, 2020L, 2025L),
    c("dry_feb", "dry_sep", "wet_may", "wet_dec"),
    FUN = function(y, w) paste(y, w, sep = "_")
  ))
  available_seasonal_keys <- names(selected_composites)
  missing_seasonal_keys <- setdiff(expected_seasonal_keys, available_seasonal_keys)
  if (length(missing_seasonal_keys) > 0L) {
    stop("Missing seasonal composites: ", paste(missing_seasonal_keys, collapse = ", "),
         ". Review the earlier image-availability and coverage checks before exporting.")
  }

  seasonal_export_tasks <- list()
  for (seasonal_key in expected_seasonal_keys) {
    image_to_export <- selected_composites[[seasonal_key]]
    export_name <- paste0("Tharaka_Seasonal_", seasonal_key)
    seasonal_task <- ee$batch$Export$image$toDrive(
      image = image_to_export,
      description = export_name,
      folder = seasonal_drive_folder,
      fileNamePrefix = export_name,
      region = roi,
      scale = 30,
      crs = "EPSG:6933",
      maxPixels = 1e13,
      fileFormat = "GeoTIFF"
    )
    seasonal_task$start()
    seasonal_export_tasks[[seasonal_key]] <- seasonal_task
    seasonal_status <- reticulate::py_to_r(seasonal_task$status())
    cat(seasonal_key, "export state:", seasonal_status[["state"]], "\n")
  }
  message("16 seasonal export tasks submitted. Wait for completion, download all GeoTIFFs from Google Drive, and place them in 01_data/landsat/qgis_input.")
} else {
  message("Seasonal composite exports are off. If local composites are missing, set export_seasonal_composites_to_drive <- TRUE and run this chunk interactively.")
}
```

# 37. Local raster processing with QGIS from R

This section uses `qgisprocess` to repair the Tharaka boundary geometry and,
when GeoTIFF files have been downloaded locally, clip those rasters to the
corrected study-area boundary. Earth Engine images must first be exported and
downloaded; `qgisprocess` cannot operate directly on server-side Earth Engine
image objects.

```{r section-37-qgisprocess-local-processing, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 37: LOCAL QGIS PROCESSING VIA qgisprocess
# =========================================================

if (!requireNamespace("qgisprocess", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install the qgisprocess package before running Section 37.")
}

# Re-confirm the QGIS executable and cache for this R Markdown session.
qgisprocess::qgis_configure()
cat("QGIS version:", qgisprocess::qgis_version(), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 40.1 Repair the local study boundary using QGIS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

boundary_source_candidates <- c(
  "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.shp",
  "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.gpkg"
)
boundary_source_candidates <- boundary_source_candidates[
  file.exists(boundary_source_candidates)
]

if (length(boundary_source_candidates) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "Tharaka boundary was not found. Expected ",
    "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.shp or .gpkg."
  )
}

boundary_source_qgis <- boundary_source_candidates[1]
boundary_fixed_dir <- "01_data/boundary/qgisprocess"
dir.create(boundary_fixed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
boundary_fixed_gpkg <- file.path(
  boundary_fixed_dir,
  "Tharaka_SubCounty_QGIS_fixed.gpkg"
)

if (file.exists(boundary_fixed_gpkg)) {
  unlink(boundary_fixed_gpkg)
}

qgisprocess::qgis_run_algorithm(
  algorithm = "native:fixgeometries",
  INPUT = boundary_source_qgis,
  OUTPUT = boundary_fixed_gpkg,
  .quiet = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(boundary_fixed_gpkg)) {
  stop("QGIS did not create the repaired boundary GeoPackage.")
}

boundary_fixed_sf <- sf::st_read(boundary_fixed_gpkg, quiet = TRUE)
if (nrow(boundary_fixed_sf) < 1L || any(!sf::st_is_valid(boundary_fixed_sf))) {
  stop("The QGIS-repaired boundary did not pass geometry validity checks.")
}

cat("QGIS boundary repair passed. Features:", nrow(boundary_fixed_sf), "\n")
cat("Corrected boundary:", normalizePath(boundary_fixed_gpkg, winslash = "/"), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 40.2 Clip local GeoTIFF rasters to the study boundary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

qgis_raster_input_dir <- "01_data/landsat/qgis_input"
qgis_raster_output_dir <- "01_data/landsat/qgis_clipped"
dir.create(qgis_raster_input_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(qgis_raster_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

local_tiffs <- list.files(
  qgis_raster_input_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(local_tiffs) == 0L) {
  message(
    "No local GeoTIFFs found. QGIS boundary processing succeeded; ",
    "download exported Landsat/composite/classification GeoTIFFs into ",
    qgis_raster_input_dir,
    " to enable raster clipping."
  )
  qgis_raster_processing_log <- tibble::tibble(
    input_file = character(),
    output_file = character(),
    status = character(),
    details = character()
  )
} else {
  qgis_raster_processing_log <- purrr::map_dfr(local_tiffs, function(input_raster) {
    output_raster <- file.path(
      qgis_raster_output_dir,
      paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_raster)), "_TharakaClip.tif")
    )

    if (file.exists(output_raster)) unlink(output_raster)

    tryCatch({
      qgisprocess::qgis_run_algorithm(
        algorithm = "gdal:cliprasterbymasklayer",
        INPUT = input_raster,
        MASK = boundary_fixed_gpkg,
        CROP_TO_CUTLINE = TRUE,
        KEEP_RESOLUTION = TRUE,
        OUTPUT = output_raster,
        .quiet = TRUE
      )

      if (!file.exists(output_raster)) {
        stop("QGIS returned without creating the clipped GeoTIFF.")
      }

      raster_check <- terra::rast(output_raster)
      tibble::tibble(
        input_file = input_raster,
        output_file = output_raster,
        status = "success",
        details = paste0(
          "bands=", terra::nlyr(raster_check),
          "; CRS=", terra::crs(raster_check, proj = TRUE)
        )
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        input_file = input_raster,
        output_file = output_raster,
        status = "failed",
        details = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    })
  })

  print(qgis_raster_processing_log, n = Inf, width = Inf)
}

qgis_log_file <- file.path(
  "02_outputs/tables",
  "Tharaka_QGIS_Processing_Log.csv"
)
readr::write_csv(qgis_raster_processing_log, qgis_log_file)
cat("QGIS processing log:", normalizePath(qgis_log_file, winslash = "/"), "\n")
```

# 38. Image-led unsupervised land-cover learning in R

This is the primary image-led analysis path in this version of the workflow. It does **not** train on the historical point labels. It uses the local QGIS-clipped, four-season Landsat composites to discover recurring spectral/seasonal pixel groups. One pooled clustering model is fitted across all four years so the cluster IDs remain comparable across years.

The first run produces cluster maps, cluster signatures, and annual area/share plots for the clusters. These are exploratory clusters, not automatically confirmed land-cover names. Review the maps and spectral signatures, complete the generated `Tharaka_Cluster_to_LandCover_Crosswalk.csv`, and rerun this section to create the named land-cover trend plots. This avoids pretending that an unsupervised algorithm knows which cluster is farmland or bushland without interpretation.

**Input requirement:** one multiband GeoTIFF per year and seasonal window (16 files total), with the first six bands in this order: blue, green, red, NIR, SWIR1, SWIR2. Filenames must include a target year (`2000`, `2010`, `2020`, or `2025`) and a month/season token (`Feb`, `Sep`, `May`, or `Dec`). If these TIFFs do not exist locally yet, run Section 36 interactively, download the 16 completed exports from Google Drive into `01_data/landsat/qgis_input`, and rerun the document so Section 40 can clip them with QGIS. The code checks the input inventory before processing.

```{r section-38-unsupervised-image-learning, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
# =========================================================
# SECTION 38: IMAGE-LED UNSUPERVISED LAND-COVER LEARNING
# Primary pathway: QGIS-clipped seasonal Landsat GeoTIFFs + R
# Does NOT use the supplied historical point labels for fitting.
# =========================================================

if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("tidyr", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("purrr", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("stringr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Section 38 requires terra, dplyr, tidyr, purrr, ggplot2, readr and stringr.")
}

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

unsup_years <- c(2000L, 2010L, 2020L, 2025L)
unsup_windows <- c("dry_feb", "dry_sep", "wet_may", "wet_dec")
unsup_bands <- c("blue", "green", "red", "nir", "swir1", "swir2")
unsup_k <- 8L                    # Try 8 initial spectral/seasonal clusters
unsup_sample_per_year <- 2500L  # Increase to 5,000 if the computer permits
set.seed(20261011)

unsup_out_dir <- file.path("Tharaka_Land_Cover_Results", "Unsupervised_Image_Learning")
unsup_feature_dir <- file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Feature_Stacks")
unsup_map_dir <- file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Cluster_Maps")
dir.create(unsup_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(unsup_feature_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(unsup_map_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Look in QGIS-clipped imagery first, then the QGIS input folder.
unsup_input_dirs <- unique(c(
  if (exists("qgis_raster_output_dir", inherits = TRUE)) qgis_raster_output_dir,
  "01_data/landsat/qgis_clipped",
  "01_data/landsat/qgis_input"
))
unsup_input_dirs <- unsup_input_dirs[dir.exists(unsup_input_dirs)]

# Convert file names into a year + seasonal-window inventory.
unsup_build_catalog <- function(files) {
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(tibble::tibble(file = character(), year = integer(), window = character()))
  nm <- tolower(basename(files))
  year_txt <- stringr::str_extract(nm, "2000|2010|2020|2025")
  window_patterns <- c(
    dry_feb = "feb(ruary)?|02[-_ ]?10",
    dry_sep = "sep(tember)?|09[-_ ]?15",
    wet_may = "may|05[-_ ]?05",
    wet_dec = "dec(ember)?|12[-_ ]?05"
  )
  window_txt <- vapply(nm, function(one_name) {
    hits <- names(window_patterns)[vapply(
      window_patterns,
      function(pat) grepl(pat, one_name, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE),
      logical(1)
    )]
    if (length(hits) == 1L) hits else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  tibble::tibble(
    file = files,
    year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year_txt)),
    window = unname(window_txt)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(window), year %in% unsup_years)
}

unsup_catalog <- NULL
unsup_selected_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate_dir in unsup_input_dirs) {
  candidate_files <- list.files(
    candidate_dir,
    pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    recursive = FALSE
  )
  candidate_catalog <- unsup_build_catalog(candidate_files)
  duplicate_pairs <- candidate_catalog %>% count(year, window) %>% filter(n != 1L)
  expected_pairs <- tidyr::crossing(year = unsup_years, window = unsup_windows)
  missing_pairs <- dplyr::anti_join(expected_pairs, candidate_catalog, by = c("year", "window"))
  if (nrow(duplicate_pairs) == 0L && nrow(missing_pairs) == 0L && nrow(candidate_catalog) == 16L) {
    unsup_catalog <- candidate_catalog %>% arrange(year, match(window, unsup_windows))
    unsup_selected_dir <- candidate_dir
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(unsup_catalog)) {
  found_files <- unlist(lapply(unsup_input_dirs, function(d) {
    list.files(d, pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  cat("GeoTIFF search folders:\n", paste(unsup_input_dirs, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  cat("GeoTIFF files found:\n", if (length(found_files)) paste(basename(found_files), collapse = "\n") else "(none)", "\n")
  warning(
    "Section 38 has been skipped because the 16 seasonal GeoTIFFs are not all available. ",
    "If needed, run Section 36 interactively, download the completed seasonal exports, ",
    "place them in 01_data/landsat/qgis_input, then rerun the document."
  )
} else {

cat("Using seasonal imagery from:", normalizePath(unsup_selected_dir, winslash = "/"), "\n")
print(unsup_catalog, n = Inf)
readr::write_csv(unsup_catalog, file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Input_Inventory.csv"))

# Use the first composite to define a common raster grid. Every other scene
# is resampled to this grid if needed. QGIS already created the study-area clips;
# when a repaired boundary is available, apply it as an additional mask.
unsup_reference <- terra::rast(unsup_catalog$file[1])[[1]]
unsup_boundary_path <- c(
  "01_data/boundary/qgisprocess/Tharaka_SubCounty_QGIS_fixed.gpkg",
  "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.shp"
)
unsup_boundary_path <- unsup_boundary_path[file.exists(unsup_boundary_path)]
unsup_mask <- NULL
if (length(unsup_boundary_path) > 0L) {
  unsup_mask <- terra::vect(unsup_boundary_path[1])
  if (!terra::same.crs(unsup_mask, unsup_reference)) {
    unsup_mask <- terra::project(unsup_mask, terra::crs(unsup_reference))
  }
}

unsup_read_aligned <- function(path) {
  x <- terra::rast(path)
  if (terra::nlyr(x) < 6L) {
    stop("Expected at least six Landsat reflectance bands in: ", basename(path))
  }
  # The exports should follow this order: blue, green, red, nir, swir1, swir2.
  # If your export used another band order, correct it here before proceeding.
  x <- x[[1:6]]
  if (!terra::same.crs(x, unsup_reference)) {
    x <- terra::project(x, unsup_reference, method = "bilinear")
  } else if (!isTRUE(terra::compareGeom(x[[1]], unsup_reference, stopOnError = FALSE))) {
    x <- terra::resample(x, unsup_reference, method = "bilinear")
  }
  names(x) <- unsup_bands
  if (!is.null(unsup_mask)) x <- terra::mask(x, unsup_mask)
  x
}

# Create 36 predictors per year: six reflectance bands and three indices for
# each of the four seasonal windows. Ratio indices use explicit arithmetic.
unsup_feature_names <- character()
unsup_feature_files <- setNames(character(length(unsup_years)), as.character(unsup_years))
for (yr in unsup_years) {
  feature_parts <- list()
  for (win in unsup_windows) {
    scene_file <- unsup_catalog %>% filter(year == yr, window == win) %>% pull(file)
    reflectance <- unsup_read_aligned(scene_file)
    names(reflectance) <- paste0(unsup_bands, "_", win)

    calc_index <- function(a, b, index_name) {
      numerator <- a - b
      denominator <- a + b
      idx <- terra::ifel(abs(denominator) < 1e-6, NA, numerator / denominator)
      names(idx) <- paste0(index_name, "_", win)
      idx
    }
    ndvi <- calc_index(reflectance[[paste0("nir_", win)]], reflectance[[paste0("red_", win)]], "NDVI")
    ndwi <- calc_index(reflectance[[paste0("green_", win)]], reflectance[[paste0("nir_", win)]], "NDWI")
    ndbi <- calc_index(reflectance[[paste0("swir1_", win)]], reflectance[[paste0("nir_", win)]], "NDBI")
    feature_parts[[win]] <- c(reflectance, ndvi, ndwi, ndbi)
  }

  feature_stack <- do.call(c, feature_parts)
  names(feature_stack) <- unlist(lapply(unsup_windows, function(win) c(
    paste0(unsup_bands, "_", win), paste0("NDVI_", win),
    paste0("NDWI_", win), paste0("NDBI_", win)
  )), use.names = FALSE)
  if (length(unsup_feature_names) == 0L) unsup_feature_names <- names(feature_stack)

  feature_path <- file.path(unsup_feature_dir, paste0("Tharaka_Features_", yr, ".tif"))
  terra::writeRaster(
    feature_stack, feature_path, overwrite = TRUE,
    wopt = list(datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  )
  unsup_feature_files[as.character(yr)] <- feature_path
  message("Prepared aligned seasonal feature stack for ", yr)
  rm(feature_stack, feature_parts)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# Sample from all four years and fit one pooled k-means model. Scaling prevents
# raw reflectance bands from dominating the bounded vegetation/water indices.
unsup_samples_list <- lapply(unsup_years, function(yr) {
  x <- terra::rast(unsup_feature_files[[as.character(yr)]])
  s <- terra::spatSample(
    x, size = unsup_sample_per_year, method = "random",
    na.rm = TRUE, as.df = TRUE, values = TRUE
  )
  s <- as.data.frame(s)
  s$sample_year <- yr
  s
})
unsup_samples <- dplyr::bind_rows(unsup_samples_list)
unsup_samples <- unsup_samples %>% filter(if_all(all_of(unsup_feature_names), ~ is.finite(.x)))
if (nrow(unsup_samples) < unsup_k * 20L) {
  stop("Too few valid multi-season pixel samples for clustering. Check cloud masks and input imagery.")
}

unsup_sample_matrix <- as.matrix(unsup_samples[, unsup_feature_names, drop = FALSE])
unsup_sd <- apply(unsup_sample_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
unsup_keep <- is.finite(unsup_sd) & unsup_sd > 1e-8
if (sum(unsup_keep) < 3L) stop("Too few variable image predictors remain after quality checks.")
unsup_used_features <- unsup_feature_names[unsup_keep]
unsup_sample_matrix <- unsup_sample_matrix[, unsup_keep, drop = FALSE]
unsup_centres <- colMeans(unsup_sample_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
unsup_scales <- apply(unsup_sample_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
unsup_scaled_samples <- scale(unsup_sample_matrix, center = unsup_centres, scale = unsup_scales)

set.seed(20261011)
unsup_kmeans <- stats::kmeans(
  unsup_scaled_samples,
  centers = unsup_k,
  iter.max = 50,
  nstart = 3
)

# Save original-scale cluster signatures. These are the evidence used to review
# and name clusters; the cluster IDs should not be called land-cover classes yet.
unsup_signature_data <- as.data.frame(unsup_sample_matrix)
unsup_signature_data$cluster <- factor(unsup_kmeans$cluster, levels = seq_len(unsup_k))
unsup_signatures <- unsup_signature_data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(unsup_used_features), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(unsup_signatures, file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_Signatures.csv"))

# Cluster assignment function used by terra::predict() on raster blocks.
unsup_model <- list(
  centers = unsup_kmeans$centers,
  center = unsup_centres,
  scale = unsup_scales,
  feature_names = unsup_used_features
)
unsup_predict_cluster <- function(model, data, ...) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  x <- as.matrix(data[, model$feature_names, drop = FALSE])
  result <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(x))
  valid <- if (nrow(x) == 0L) logical(0) else complete.cases(x) & apply(x, 1, function(z) all(is.finite(z)))
  if (any(valid)) {
    z <- scale(x[valid, , drop = FALSE], center = model$center, scale = model$scale)
    d2 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(z), ncol = nrow(model$centers))
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(model$centers))) {
      delta <- sweep(z, 2, model$centers[j, ], FUN = "-")
      d2[, j] <- rowSums(delta * delta)
    }
    result[valid] <- max.col(-d2, ties.method = "first")
  }
  data.frame(cluster = result)
}

# Map all years with the same pooled model, then estimate area by cluster.
unsup_cluster_map_files <- setNames(character(length(unsup_years)), as.character(unsup_years))
unsup_area_by_cluster <- list()
unsup_map_colours <- grDevices::hcl.colors(unsup_k, palette = "Dynamic")
for (yr in unsup_years) {
  feature_stack <- terra::rast(unsup_feature_files[[as.character(yr)]])[[unsup_used_features]]
  cluster_path <- file.path(unsup_map_dir, paste0("Tharaka_Unsupervised_Clusters_", yr, ".tif"))
  cluster_map <- terra::predict(
    feature_stack, unsup_model, fun = unsup_predict_cluster,
    na.rm = TRUE, filename = cluster_path, overwrite = TRUE,
    wopt = list(datatype = "INT1U", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  )
  unsup_cluster_map_files[as.character(yr)] <- cluster_path

  png(file.path(unsup_map_dir, paste0("Tharaka_Unsupervised_Clusters_", yr, ".png")),
      width = 1600, height = 1200, res = 150)
  terra::plot(terra::as.factor(cluster_map), col = unsup_map_colours,
               main = paste("Tharaka Sub-county — image-derived clusters", yr),
               axes = TRUE)
  dev.off()

  area_raster <- terra::cellSize(cluster_map, unit = "ha")
  z <- terra::zonal(area_raster, cluster_map, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
  z <- as.data.frame(z)
  if (ncol(z) >= 2L) {
    names(z)[1:2] <- c("cluster", "area_ha")
    unsup_area_by_cluster[[as.character(yr)]] <- tibble::as_tibble(z) %>%
      mutate(year = yr, cluster = as.integer(cluster)) %>%
      select(year, cluster, area_ha)
  }
  rm(feature_stack, cluster_map, area_raster, z)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

unsup_cluster_area_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(unsup_area_by_cluster) %>%
  group_by(year, cluster) %>%
  summarise(area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
unsup_cluster_area <- tidyr::crossing(year = unsup_years, cluster = seq_len(unsup_k)) %>%
  left_join(unsup_cluster_area_raw, by = c("year", "cluster")) %>%
  mutate(area_ha = tidyr::replace_na(area_ha, 0)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    mapped_area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_percent = if_else(mapped_area_ha > 0, 100 * area_ha / mapped_area_ha, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(year, cluster)
readr::write_csv(unsup_cluster_area, file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_Area_Trends.csv"))

p_unsup_cluster_area <- ggplot(unsup_cluster_area, aes(x = year, y = area_ha, colour = factor(cluster), group = cluster)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unsup_years) +
  labs(title = "Image-derived cluster area trends in Tharaka Sub-county",
       subtitle = paste0("Pooled k-means on four seasonal Landsat composites; k = ", unsup_k),
       x = "Year", y = "Area (ha)", colour = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_Area_Trends.png"), p_unsup_cluster_area, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p_unsup_cluster_area)

p_unsup_cluster_share <- ggplot(unsup_cluster_area, aes(x = year, y = share_percent, colour = factor(cluster), group = cluster)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unsup_years) +
  labs(title = "Share of mapped pixels by image-derived cluster",
       subtitle = "Shares use the valid mapped area in each year as the denominator",
       x = "Year", y = "Mapped area (%)", colour = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_Share_Trends.png"), p_unsup_cluster_share, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p_unsup_cluster_share)

# Seasonal vegetation-index profile is especially useful for interpreting
# woody vegetation, grassland and cultivated areas with seasonal growth.
ndvi_signature_cols <- grep("^NDVI_", names(unsup_signatures), value = TRUE)
if (length(ndvi_signature_cols) > 0L) {
  unsup_ndvi_profile <- unsup_signatures %>%
    select(cluster, all_of(ndvi_signature_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "mean_ndvi") %>%
    mutate(window = stringr::str_remove(feature, "^NDVI_"),
           window = factor(window, levels = unsup_windows))
  p_unsup_ndvi <- ggplot(unsup_ndvi_profile, aes(x = window, y = mean_ndvi, colour = factor(cluster), group = cluster)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal NDVI signatures by cluster",
         subtitle = "Use alongside the cluster maps and reflectance signatures when naming clusters",
         x = "Seasonal window", y = "Mean NDVI", colour = "Cluster") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  ggsave(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_NDVI_Signatures.png"), p_unsup_ndvi, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p_unsup_ndvi)
}

# Create a reviewable crosswalk once. The script will not overwrite your edits.
unsup_crosswalk_file <- file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Cluster_to_LandCover_Crosswalk.csv")
if (!file.exists(unsup_crosswalk_file)) {
  readr::write_csv(
    tibble::tibble(
      cluster = seq_len(unsup_k),
      land_cover = "",
      interpretation_notes = "Review map + seasonal spectral signatures before assigning"
    ),
    unsup_crosswalk_file
  )
  message("Created blank cluster-to-cover crosswalk: ", unsup_crosswalk_file)
}

unsup_crosswalk <- readr::read_csv(unsup_crosswalk_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                                   col_types = cols(cluster = col_integer(), land_cover = col_character(), interpretation_notes = col_character()))
allowed_unsup_classes <- c("forest", "bushland", "grassland", "farmland", "settlement", "other_uncertain")
crosswalk_complete <- all(c("cluster", "land_cover") %in% names(unsup_crosswalk)) &&
  setequal(unsup_crosswalk$cluster, seq_len(unsup_k)) &&
  all(!is.na(unsup_crosswalk$land_cover)) &&
  all(nzchar(trimws(unsup_crosswalk$land_cover))) &&
  all(tolower(trimws(unsup_crosswalk$land_cover)) %in% allowed_unsup_classes)

if (crosswalk_complete) {
  unsup_crosswalk <- unsup_crosswalk %>% mutate(land_cover = tolower(trimws(land_cover)))
  unsup_named_area <- unsup_cluster_area %>%
    left_join(unsup_crosswalk %>% select(cluster, land_cover), by = "cluster") %>%
    group_by(year, land_cover) %>%
    summarise(area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  named_classes <- sort(unique(unsup_crosswalk$land_cover))
  unsup_named_area <- tidyr::crossing(year = unsup_years, land_cover = named_classes) %>%
    left_join(unsup_named_area, by = c("year", "land_cover")) %>%
    mutate(area_ha = tidyr::replace_na(area_ha, 0)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(mapped_area_ha = sum(area_ha), share_percent = if_else(mapped_area_ha > 0, 100 * area_ha / mapped_area_ha, NA_real_)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% arrange(year, land_cover)

  readr::write_csv(unsup_named_area, file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Image_Learned_LandCover_Area_Trends.csv"))
  p_unsup_named_area <- ggplot(unsup_named_area, aes(x = year, y = area_ha, colour = land_cover, group = land_cover)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ land_cover, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unsup_years) +
    labs(title = "Image-learned land-cover area trends in Tharaka Sub-county",
         subtitle = "Cluster names were assigned through the reviewed cluster crosswalk",
         x = "Year", y = "Area (ha)", colour = "Land cover") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggsave(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Image_Learned_LandCover_Area_Trends.png"), p_unsup_named_area, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p_unsup_named_area)

  p_unsup_named_share <- ggplot(unsup_named_area, aes(x = year, y = share_percent, colour = land_cover, group = land_cover)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ land_cover, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unsup_years) +
    labs(title = "Image-learned land-cover composition trends in Tharaka Sub-county",
         subtitle = "Percentages are relative to each year's valid mapped area",
         x = "Year", y = "Mapped area (%)", colour = "Land cover") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggsave(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Image_Learned_LandCover_Share_Trends.png"), p_unsup_named_share, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p_unsup_named_share)
  message("Named class trends completed using the reviewed crosswalk.")
} else {
  message(
    "Cluster-area and cluster-share plots are ready. To produce named land-cover trends, open ",
    unsup_crosswalk_file,
    ", assign each cluster one of: ", paste(allowed_unsup_classes, collapse = ", "),
    ", save it, and rerun Section 38. Multiple clusters may share the same land-cover label."
  )
}

cat("\nImage-led clustering outputs saved under: ", normalizePath(unsup_out_dir, winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Cluster area table: ", normalizePath(file.path(unsup_out_dir, "Tharaka_Unsupervised_Cluster_Area_Trends.csv"), winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Crosswalk to review: ", normalizePath(unsup_crosswalk_file, winslash = "/"), "\n", sep = "")
}

```

## Interpretation and validation note

This is an exploratory, image-derived classification. Cluster trends are quantitative patterns in spectral/seasonal groups; they become named land-cover trends only after the crosswalk has been reviewed against the imagery. A crosswalk reviewed by the analyst is not an independent accuracy assessment. For stronger reporting, validate mapped classes with a separate, year-appropriate sample and report class-specific accuracy and area uncertainty. Compare scene quality, cloud/no-data coverage and mapped-area totals before interpreting a change as real land-cover conversion.
